sections.heading: Paper by paper: the technique that actually moves English B marks
paragraphs: Start with the single highest-return habit, which is planning before writing. A student who begins a Paper 1 response at the first sentence is making the audience decision, the text-type decision and the structure decision while already writing, and the register slips in the second paragraph because no decision was ever fixed. The drill is a plan short enough to fit in a margin: who is reading this, what text type is it, what are the three moves, how does it end. A tutor should make the student produce plans without writing the piece, five tasks in a row, until the plan takes almost no time. IB DP English B home tuition in Mumbai spent on plans alone for a fortnight looks like slow progress and is not.

Then writing to the task rather than to length. Students believe more words means more marks, so they pad, drift off the audience and finish with a response that is longer and weaker. The fix is uncomfortable and quick: give the student a task, make them write a short response that does everything the task asked, and compare it against their usual long one with the criteria open. Most students only need to see this once.

Next, the error list, which is the most boring and most effective artefact in the subject. Every student repeats a small set of inaccuracies under time: an agreement slip, a tense that shifts mid-paragraph, a dropped article, a connective used where it does not fit. The list is personal and short, and drilling it beats any general grammar book. None of this is about one variety of English being better than another; a Mumbai student who speaks Marathi, Hindi, Gujarati or Tamil alongside English is multilingual, and the examination simply rewards one defined register, which is a skill added rather than a replacement for how anyone speaks at home.

The last technique is the one families skip: the student marks their own script. Give them the published criteria, make them award themselves a mark for their own piece and write one sentence of justification per criterion, and only then let the tutor mark it. Compare the two. The gap between the student's self-mark and the tutor's mark is the most useful number in the whole arrangement, and it closes over a term. A student who can mark their own work has internalised the criteria, and a student who has internalised the criteria stops needing the tutor, which is the point. The same discipline applies to reading drills: underline the words in the passage that produced the answer, every time, until it is automatic.

sections.heading: What four weeks, one term and one exam cycle realistically look like
paragraphs: Four weeks buys you clarity and one habit. Clarity means the tutor can show you, on your child's own scripts, which component is leaking marks and what the three recurring errors are. One habit means something small is now automatic: usually underlining the textual evidence in reading, or producing a plan before writing. Grades at four weeks are a coin toss and anyone who promises otherwise is guessing on your money.

A term is where technique pays. Reading accuracy often improves sharply, because text-based answering is a rule rather than a skill and rules install fast. Text-type choice improves similarly. Listening improves if the practice material has been honest, and stalls completely if the student has been working on slow classroom recordings. The self-mark gap narrows, which is the clearest internal signal that the criteria have landed. What does not move much in a term is range of expression, which grows at its own pace and cannot be drilled.

Over a full exam cycle the honest deliverable is a student who walks in having done the examined act repeatedly: timed handwritten responses, reading answered from the text, listening at real speed with one replay used deliberately, and an oral rehearsed often enough to be boring. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor offers a guaranteed grade in English B, because the final mark depends on the paper set, the examiner, the day and the work the student does alone. Families looking for the best IB tutor in Mumbai are often really looking for a guarantee, and the useful thing to buy instead is a tutor who tells you the truth in week four.

When it is not working, the signals are specific. The tutor cannot name your child's recurring errors. Scripts come back with ticks and no criterion referenced. Your child is being taught content when the marked paper says the problem was technique. Sessions have become homework help. Any of those in the first month is a mismatch, not a settling-in period. Message us, and we shortlist again with the diagnosis we already have, which means the replacement starts from a known position rather than from scratch. There is no charge and no argument.

sections.heading: Starting English B home tuition in Mumbai
paragraphs: Prepare four things and the first session is worth several. One marked English B script with the teacher's comments intact, photographed. The level, Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL). The school's assessment calendar, with the oral window on it. And a place in the flat where the student can write by hand for a stretch without the television in earshot, which sounds trivial and decides more sessions than anything else on the list.

The first session is a diagnosis across all three components, run quickly. Expect a short unseen reading passage answered under time, one authentic listening clip played with a single replay, a plan produced for a Paper 1 task without writing the piece, and a few minutes of unscripted speaking on an image. At the end you should get a written diagnosis in plain language: what the component problem is, what the three recurring errors are, and what will be drilled first. Not a syllabus overview, which you can already read.

Expect an order of work and ask for it explicitly. Technique is sequential, and a tutor who proposes to do everything at once will reach March having moved nothing measurably. The normal order is whatever has the nearest school deadline, then reading technique because it installs fastest, then the plan-before-writing habit, with the error list and the self-marking running underneath from the first week to the last.

On cost, IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the level, the scarcity of the specialism, the session length, whether the tutor travels to you and how far, and English B is scarcer than most parents assume because so few teachers here have taught a language acquisition course. A home tuition slot that includes an evening run to Kasarvadavali or Panvel is priced differently from the same hour in Khar West. We will not post a figure, we will explain what the range depends on, and the tutor quotes their own rate before you commit. Parents who type IB tutors near me Mumbai into a search box are often surprised that distance shows up in the price; it shows up in reliability too.

faqs.question: My child understands English fine but keeps losing reading marks. Why?
faqs.answer: Almost always because the answers are coming from general knowledge rather than from the passage. English B reading questions have answers that sit in the text, and a true-or-false question asking for a justification wants the line from the text, not a reason that sounds convincing. A student with opinions about the topic will supply those opinions and be marked wrong while feeling right. The drill is mechanical: locate the words in the passage, underline them, answer from them. It takes a few weeks of repetition and then it stops being a loss area.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our building in Powai for an evening home tuition slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the practical answer is to match somebody who already lives nearby. Powai has no station of its own, so a tutor arrives by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar along JVLR, and that trip behaves very differently at 4pm and at 7pm. A tutor based in or near Powai or Chandivali holds a weekday evening slot for two years; a better-credentialled one coming from Bandra across the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road will manage a month and then start rescheduling. For a scarce specialism we will sometimes propose a local tutor plus online listening work.

faqs.question: How does the writing paper reward register, and can that be taught?
faqs.answer: It can be taught quickly, which is why it is the first thing a good tutor attacks. Paper 1 gives an audience and a purpose, and the response has to hold the conventions of the chosen text type throughout: a set of instructions for a school noticeboard opens differently, uses a different person and ends differently from an article on the same subject. The drill is to write the same content for three different audiences in one session and compare them with the criteria open. Most students fix this inside a term, long before their general accuracy moves.

faqs.question: What is the right way to use the replay in the listening section?
faqs.answer: Deliberately, and for one thing. The audio runs at real conversational speed, and the common failure is not weak listening: it is a student who misses one answer, keeps thinking about it, and loses the next two. The habit to build is to let a missed item go, mark it, and come back on the replay. Speakers also correct themselves mid-sentence and the answer is the correction, not the first version. None of this improves on slowed classroom recordings, so practice has to use authentic audio at full pace.

faqs.question: Does writing more get more marks?
faqs.answer: No, and believing it costs marks. A long response that drifts away from the stated audience scores below a shorter one that does everything the task asked, because the criteria reward purpose, register and organisation rather than volume. The quickest cure is to make the student write one short response that hits every element of the task, then lay it beside their usual long one with the criteria in hand. Most students need to see that comparison once. Length guidance for any component should come from the current subject guide and your teacher, not from a tutoring page.

faqs.question: Will the tutor correct my child's coursework before submission?
faqs.answer: No. A tutor may teach a skill, model a strong example, mark a draft against the published criteria and say plainly that a paragraph does not do its job. A tutor may not write, redraft or supply any part of what your child submits, including a single sentence or a line of the oral. If a tutor offers to improve a draft by editing it directly, that is the point to stop the arrangement. The version of help that actually raises a mark is feedback the student then acts on by themselves, which is also the version that survives the exam room.

faqs.question: We are on Ghodbunder Road in Thane. Will the evening commute make home classes unreliable?
faqs.answer: It is the main reason Thane arrangements fail, so design around it. Ghodbunder Road out towards Kasarvadavali moves freely off-peak and slowly in the evening peak, so a tutor near Thane station will promise 6pm and deliver 6.40pm often enough to matter. Two reliable fixes: match a tutor already living on your stretch, in Majiwada, Hiranandani Estate or Kasarvadavali, or take a weekend home tuition slot for the marking conversation and handwritten practice and run a short midweek online session for listening drills.

faqs.question: What is self-marking and why do you insist on it?
faqs.answer: Self-marking means the student awards themselves a mark against the published criteria, writes one line of justification per criterion, and only then sees the tutor's mark. The gap between the two is the most useful signal in the arrangement, and watching it narrow over a term tells you the criteria have been internalised rather than merely explained. A student who can mark their own work can correct their own work in an exam, where no tutor is present. It is slow and unglamorous and it is the difference between a student who improves and one who collects corrections.

faqs.question: Is it too late to start in the second year of the Diploma?
faqs.answer: Not too late, but the return is smaller and more selective. Reading technique, text-type choice and the planning habit all install within weeks, so a DP2 start still gains real marks there. What a late start cannot buy is range of expression and general accuracy, which grow slowly from a personal error list and need repetition over terms. A student starting in the February of DP2 should expect a tutor to triage ruthlessly: the component that is leaking most, the habits that install fastest, nothing else. In DP1 the same tutor would work on everything.

faqs.question: How much should we expect to pay for English B home tuition?
faqs.answer: We do not publish a figure, because a number on a page is either stale or an anchor. The rate depends on the level, on how scarce the specialism is, on session length, on whether the tutor is travelling to your home and how far through the evening peak. English B is scarcer in Mumbai than Maths or Economics, since most English teachers here have taught literature-based courses. A session in Khar West and a session involving a run to Panvel or Kasarvadavali are priced differently. The tutor quotes their rate directly and you agree it before the trial.

faqs.question: What do we do if the tutor is simply not working out?
faqs.answer: Tell us, in one sentence, and we re-match at no cost. The signals worth acting on in the first month are specific: the tutor cannot name your child's recurring errors, scripts come back with ticks and no reference to a criterion, or sessions have turned into homework supervision. None of that is a settling-in period. Because we already hold the diagnosis from the trial and the marked script you sent, a replacement tutor starts from a known position rather than spending three sessions discovering it again. We do not ask you to justify the decision.

faqs.question: Does my child need to be good at English before English B tuition helps?
faqs.answer: No, and the question slightly misreads the subject. English B assesses a defined set of skills against published criteria, so the useful question is which of those skills is weak and what technique addresses it. Students who speak English very comfortably often have the most to gain, because their losses are usually technical rather than linguistic. A Mumbai student moving between several languages in a day is multilingual, which the Diploma treats as the asset it is. Which language course a student is entered for is settled by the school with the family, and the DP coordinator is the person to ask about it.

sections.heading: Where the writing task and the individual oral sit in English B
paragraphs: English B is the language acquisition course in the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), taken at Standard Level (SL) or Higher Level (HL) over DP1 and DP2. Two of its assessed pieces are productive rather than receptive: the student has to make something in English rather than understand something written or spoken by somebody else. Those are the written task and the individual oral, and between them they carry most of the work a home tutor will be doing with your child.

The written task asks for a piece of text aimed at a stated audience, for a stated purpose, in a text type chosen from a set of options. The individual oral is internally assessed, recorded by the school and marked by the teacher. At Standard Level it begins from a visual stimulus connected to one of the course themes; the student speaks about the stimulus and then holds a conversation about it and about the theme behind it. At Higher Level the oral is built on a literary work studied during the course instead. The themes that frame both pieces are the familiar ones: identities, experiences, human ingenuity, social organisation, sharing the planet.

The practical consequence of the theme structure is that preparation is cumulative rather than last-minute. A student who has worked through the themes with material and opinions of her own can speak about a stimulus she has never seen, because she is not inventing content under pressure; she is selecting from content she already has. A student who has revised vocabulary lists has nothing to select from and improvises, which is where turns run dry after ninety seconds.

We log a request as an English B IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai request with the level attached, since the Standard Level and Higher Level oral preparations diverge completely. For exactly how the components are structured in the year your child sits them, including anything that looks like a timing, a length or a weighting, ask your school's DP coordinator and read the current subject guide. The IB revises these on its own schedule and no tutoring page should be your source.

sections.heading: Choosing the right text type: a blog is not a formal letter
paragraphs: The first thing an IB DP English B home tutor in Mumbai usually has to fix is text type, because the most expensive mistake in the written task is answering well in the wrong form. A student reads a prompt, recognises the topic, and writes the kind of composition she has written since Year 8. The content may be sensible and the English may be clean, and the marks still go because a task asking for a speech received an essay. Text type is not decoration on top of the writing. It is part of what is being assessed, and it is the quickest thing a home tutor can fix.

Take four forms that students treat as interchangeable and are not. A speech addresses people who are present: it needs an opening that acknowledges them, signposting so that listeners can follow without re-reading, rhetorical structure, and an ending designed to be heard rather than skimmed. A formal letter states its business early, maintains distance, and makes a specific request or recommendation before it closes. A blog post can be personal, can speak directly to a reader, can use short paragraphs and a conversational register, and usually carries a voice. An article is written for a publication and its readers: it needs a headline, an opening that earns attention, attributed examples, and a neutral or clearly signalled stance. Write the right content in the wrong one of those four and you have lost marks that had nothing to do with your English.

The discipline that prevents this is mechanical and takes about two minutes. Before writing, name the audience, name the purpose, and name the text type, then write the three words at the top of the page. Then choose the opening those three require together. A student who does that consistently stops producing general essays in response to specific tasks, and the improvement usually shows within three or four marked pieces, which is why writing is the component that moves first.

Register follows from the same three words. The vocabulary, the sentence length, how much knowledge is assumed, how direct a request can be: all of it changes between a text for classmates and a text for a municipal official. A good English B tutor in Mumbai will not teach register as a rule to memorise but will set the same content as two different text types for two different audiences and let the student see the difference on her own page.

Accuracy work belongs here too, and it should be individual. The useful method is to collect three or four pieces of the student's own writing, mark what actually recurs, and work on the two patterns that cost most. That might be tense sequence slipping in longer sentences, article use in complex noun phrases, or one preposition that keeps going astray. General grammar drills spend most of their time on structures the student already handles correctly, which is why they feel productive and change little.

sections.heading: When the oral gets recorded in the Mumbai school year
paragraphs: The individual oral is recorded at school during DP2, on dates the department sets, and those dates are the ones your household should be planning around. They are usually well before the external examination season, and they tend to land in the same months as science Internal Assessment (IA) drafts, the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay and the final Extended Essay (EE) deadline. A student who has done no sustained speaking practice until the term of the recording is preparing for an assessment at the worst possible moment in the two years.

Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School and the American School of Bombay in BKC, at Ascend International School, at Ecole Mondiale World School, Jamnabai Narsee International School and Utpal Shanghvi Global School in Juhu, at Oberoi International School off JVLR, at B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, at Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, at Bombay International School near Babulnath, at Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, at Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, at NES International School in Mulund West, at the JBCN International School campuses in Parel, Borivali, Oshiwara and Chembur, at Singapore International School in Dahisar East, at Bombay Cambridge International School in Andheri East, at Thakur International School in Kandivali East or at D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul all work to a similar shape. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of those schools or with the International Baccalaureate organisation; they are named here only because their calendars are the ones Mumbai parents organise their weeks around.

The sensible plan runs backwards from the recording date. Six to eight weeks before, practice turns should be happening weekly with a different stimulus every time. Three to four months before, the themes should be getting substantive content: examples, opinions, a few facts the student can actually use. In DP1 the work is quieter and more valuable than it looks, which is simply speaking at length regularly on whatever the class is covering so that holding the floor stops feeling unusual.

One Mumbai-specific wrinkle is worth planning for. School internal deadlines for recordings sometimes move when a department has to fit a whole cohort into a recording window, and families hear about the change late. Ask for the window early in DP2, ask again in the term it falls, and give the tutor the date as soon as you have it so the last six weeks of preparation are not compressed into three. An IB tutor Mumbai parents brief with the actual school calendar plans better than one working from a general timetable.

sections.heading: Why most English B oral practice happens as home tuition in Mumbai
paragraphs: Speaking practice works better in a room, and that is the main argument for hiring an IB DP English B home tutor in Mumbai rather than working entirely online. A student rehearsing an oral has to get used to being looked at while she thinks, to filling a silence rather than waiting for a prompt, and to carrying on when she has used her best point too early. All of those are easier to simulate in person. IB home tuition in Mumbai also makes a difference for students who are self-conscious about speaking, because the audience is one familiar person rather than a screen with their own face on it.

Home classes have a second, more mundane advantage for this course. The tutor sees the room the student will be working in and can fix what is wrong with it: the chair that faces the television, the corner where the lift machinery is audible, the fact that the only quiet hour in the flat is at seven in the morning. For oral rehearsal a reliably quiet forty minutes is not a nicety, and families often need someone from outside the household to point out that it does not currently exist.

The honest costs are familiar. Home tuition carries the tutor's travel, so a tutor crossing from Bandra to Chembur in the evening peak costs more than one from Chembur. Monsoon makes long journeys unreliable. And a home slot is hard to move twice, because each cancellation wastes someone's journey. An IB private tutor Mumbai families keep for two years is usually one who lives close enough that the weekly trip is unremarkable.

Online still has its place and should be used for the things it does better. Listening practice with replay and transcripts is genuinely better on a call. So is quick feedback on a typed piece of writing between sessions. And an IB online tutor in Mumbai widens the pool when the specialist who has actually prepared students for recorded orals is in Thane and you live in Colaba. The common settlement is a weekly home session for speaking and marked writing plus one short online slot midweek, shifting further towards home sessions in the two months before the recording.

sections.heading: How do we check a home tutor before the first session in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Identity is verified against government photographic identification before any home visit, qualifications are confirmed, and teaching history is recorded by board, level and the components actually taught. For this page's intent we ask one extra question of every tutor: has she prepared students for an internally assessed recorded oral, and can she describe how she rehearses without producing a script. The answer to the second half tells you a great deal, because scripting is the common shortcut and it damages the student in the room.

We also verify the ordinary conditions that make a weekly home arrangement last: that the tutor is genuinely within reach of your zone, that the slot can hold for a full term, and that she will deal with you directly over rescheduling. References from earlier families are taken where they are offered and never invented where they are not.

Your own checking is the part that counts most, and the first visit is the moment for it. Ask for identification at the door. Ask which themes she has taught and how she would build material for them with your child. Ask what she does when a student dries up after ninety seconds. And state the boundary out loud, early, so that nobody is embarrassed later: she may teach, rehearse and mark drafts against the published criteria, and she may not write, redraft or supply any part of a submitted piece or script an oral. Be wary of a tutor who promises a specific grade, and treat an offer to polish a submitted text as a reason to end the arrangement rather than a favour.

The search that brings most parents here is for the best IB tutor in Mumbai, and for this subject it is the wrong question to be asking. The right one is narrower: has this person prepared students for this assessment, can she reach your flat at a time your child can still concentrate, and will she make your child speak for four minutes when your child would rather speak for one. IB Gram does not guarantee grades and no tutor matched here is permitted to offer one.

sections.heading: How should a student talk about the visual stimulus instead of listing it?
paragraphs: Describe what the image is doing, not what is in it, and this is the first thing an IB DP English B home tutor in Mumbai should be drilling before a recording window. A student who says there are three people, a building and a flag has used forty seconds to tell the examiner something the examiner can see. A student who says the photograph is composed so that the crowd fills the frame and the official is cut off at the edge, and that this makes the event look popular rather than organised, has made a claim. The claim can then be supported, extended, and argued about, which is exactly what the rest of the turn and the conversation need.

A workable structure for the turn has four moves. First, place the image under its theme in one sentence, which is where the cumulative theme work pays off. Second, make an analytical observation about how it has been constructed: what is central, what is at the edge, what the angle or the colour or the text does, and who the image seems to be addressing. Third, say what it is arguing or assuming, including what it leaves out. Fourth, connect it outward to something real the student knows about, from her own city, her reading or her experience. Four moves, each extendable, and no two stimuli producing the same turn.

The honest difficulty is that students want to prepare by writing out one perfect response and learning it. Rehearsing without memorising is the skill a home tutor should be teaching, and the method is to vary the stimulus rather than to repeat the performance. Practise the four moves on ten unrelated images across a term, never twice on the same one, and record the turns so the student hears what a thought-out sentence sounds like against a remembered one. A memorised answer collapses the moment the first follow-up question steps outside the script, and it usually sounds memorised long before that.

The conversation phase then rewards having opinions rather than having material. A student should be able to say which of two positions she holds and why, to concede a point and keep her overall line, and to ask for a question to be repeated without losing her composure. These are all practisable at home, and the most useful thing a tutor can do is to disagree with the student deliberately and let her defend herself. That is uncomfortable in week one and ordinary by week six.

One more time, because this is the component where the pressure to cross the line is highest. A tutor may rehearse with the student, feed back on a practice turn, and mark written drafts against the criteria. A tutor may not write the oral, supply the sentences, or provide any part of what the student says or submits under assessment conditions. The academic honesty risk belongs to the student, and any help beyond coaching puts her at risk rather than ahead.
bullets: Say what the image is doing and arguing, not what it contains
Four moves: place it, analyse the construction, state the argument, connect out
Practise on ten different stimuli, never repeat one performance

sections.heading: What improves first, and what can a home tutor not fix?
paragraphs: Writing moves fastest, usually inside three or four marked pieces, because text-type conventions and the audience-and-purpose discipline are rules rather than capabilities. Expect the first visible win there. Oral confidence moves in steps and is uneven: a student can have a poor week after a good one, generally because she tried something harder. Precision in the recurring error patterns improves steadily once the patterns have been identified and named, and stalls if nobody has bothered to identify them.

At four weeks you should have a written diagnosis rather than a mark: the two or three error patterns that recur in her own writing, which text types she handles badly, and how long she can currently speak before she runs dry. At one term, expect correctly chosen text types, openings that match the audience, and practice turns that reach a reasonable length with content rather than filler. Over an exam cycle the outcome depends on her starting point, on how much English she reads and hears outside sessions, and on what DP2 is demanding of her elsewhere. We do not guarantee grades and will not predict one; her teacher has the evidence for that conversation and we do not.

Three things a home tutor genuinely cannot do. She cannot create exposure: a student who reads and listens to nothing in English between sessions improves slowly whatever happens in the room. She cannot manufacture a quiet forty minutes in a flat where none exists, though she can tell you honestly that the arrangement is not working. And she cannot write any part of the assessment, which is a limit worth being grateful for rather than frustrated by.

If a tutor is not working out, say so in a sentence and a replacement shortlist comes back without an argument. The common mismatches in this subject are specific: a tutor who corrects constantly during speaking practice so the student stops taking risks, a tutor who runs general grammar lessons instead of targeting the student's own patterns, and a tutor who treats a multilingual student as though her other languages were an obstacle rather than the asset they are. Any of those is a reason to change, and changing at week four is far cheaper than changing at month four.

sections.heading: Booking a home tutor for English B Mumbai families keep for two years
paragraphs: Send four things with the enquiry. The level, Standard or Higher, because the oral preparation differs entirely. The themes the class has covered. Two pieces of the student's writing of different text types with the teacher's marks on them. And the recording window for the oral if the school has given it, or a note that you will ask for it.

The first session is a diagnostic and should produce something you can keep. The tutor sets a short written task with a named audience and purpose and sees whether the right text type arrives. She puts an unfamiliar image in front of the student and asks for a few minutes on it, then disagrees with something to see what happens. By the end you should have, in writing, the recurring error patterns, the text types that need work, how long the student can currently speak with real content, and what the next six weeks will target.

Settle the practical arrangements in the same session rather than by message later: the fixed weekly slot and a single backup day, the society gate pass or visitor registration so a standing weekly appointment does not need a phone call every week, which room the sessions will use and what has to be turned off in it, and whether a parent needs to be at home. Families who treat the slot as immovable get the benefit; families who move it whenever something comes up are usually the ones disappointed in DP2.

Finally, the sentence to repeat to every tutor you ever hire for this course. Teach her, question her, rehearse with her, mark her drafts against the criteria. Do not write, script or supply one word of what she submits. Any tutor who finds that restrictive is the wrong tutor, and should be reported to us and replaced.

faqs.question: My son writes well but keeps losing marks on the written task. What is going wrong?
faqs.answer: Most often he is writing the right content in the wrong text type. A task asking for a speech, a blog post or a formal letter is asking for that form's conventions, and a well-written general essay does not satisfy it. The fix is quick and mechanical: before writing anything he names the audience, the purpose and the text type, writes those three words at the top of the page, and chooses the opening they require together. Three or four marked pieces usually settle the habit, which is why writing is the component that improves first.

faqs.question: Can a tutor write or script the individual oral for my daughter?
faqs.answer: No, and nobody should offer to. A tutor may rehearse with her, critique a practice turn, build her material under the course themes and mark written drafts against the published criteria. She may not write, script or supply any part of what your daughter says under assessment conditions or hands in. The academic honesty risk sits with the student, so a scripted oral puts her at risk rather than ahead, and it also performs badly: a memorised answer collapses at the first follow-up question that steps outside it. If any tutor offers, end the arrangement and tell us.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to Breach Candy or Napean Sea Road for an early evening home session?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we match within the island for it. South Mumbai distances are short and the evening signals at Peddar Road and Haji Ali are what actually set the timing, so a tutor based in Walkeshwar, Tardeo or Breach Candy holds a 6.30pm slot that a tutor coming down from the suburbs will miss roughly every third week. Metro Line 3 and the Coastal Road have helped, mainly for journeys from BKC and Worli. Tell us your preferred start time with the enquiry and the shortlist will be built around it.

faqs.question: How does a student practise speaking without memorising an answer?
faqs.answer: By varying the stimulus rather than repeating the performance. The method is to learn a structure, place the image under its theme, analyse how it is constructed, say what it argues and leaves out, then connect it to something real, and apply that structure to ten unrelated images across a term, never twice to the same one. Recording the turns helps, because the student can hear the difference between a sentence she is thinking and one she is reciting. A memorised turn sounds memorised and falls apart the moment a follow-up question arrives.

faqs.question: Which text types should we practise at home?
faqs.answer: The ones on the option list your school works from, and enough of them that no prompt is a surprise. In practice that means a blog post, a formal letter, a speech, an article, a report, a set of instructions or guidelines, an email and a diary or personal entry. Practise them in pairs with the same content written twice for different audiences, since that is what teaches register faster than any explanation. Ask the tutor to mark against the published criteria and to say explicitly which convention was missing rather than simply correcting the language.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for English B home tuition?
faqs.answer: What an IB DP English B home tutor in Mumbai charges turns on level, session length and frequency, travel, and how scarce the right tutor is in your zone. Higher Level preparation involves literary works and takes longer. Marked written work costs more to return than a conversation does. Home tuition includes the tutor's journey, so a tutor from your own node is cheaper than one crossing the city at 6pm, and a tutor who has actually prepared students for recorded orals is scarcer than a general English teacher. We publish no price list, because a figure detached from your zone and slot misleads. Ask for a range once you have names.

faqs.question: Does the tutor need to come to our building every week, or can some sessions be online?
faqs.answer: A mix is usually best and most families settle into one. The in-person session carries speaking rehearsal and the discussion of marked writing, where being in the same room matters. Short online slots handle listening practice with replay and quick feedback on a typed piece. Before the recording window, shift the balance towards sessions in your building, since what needs rehearsing by then is one person talking to another. Agree the pattern at the start rather than drifting into whichever is convenient in a given week.

faqs.question: My daughter speaks three languages at home. Does that hold her back in English B?
faqs.answer: No. Moving between Marathi, Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil or any other language and English every day makes her multilingual, which is an asset in a language acquisition course and in life. Nothing about it makes her a weaker candidate, and any tutor who treats her other languages as interference is the wrong tutor. What the course assesses is whether she can understand authentic English texts and produce English effectively for a stated audience and purpose, and those are specific skills that anyone can be taught. Which English course she takes is a placement decision for the school and your family.

faqs.question: How much time should we give this each week in DP2?
faqs.answer: One substantial home session plus short independent work most days beats three long sessions with nothing between them. The independent work is the part that moves listening and reading, and it can be twenty minutes of English listening or an article read with the question what does the writer think in mind. In the six to eight weeks before the oral recording, add one weekly practice turn on a fresh stimulus. Adding sessions without independent exposure tends to produce a student who performs well with her tutor present and freezes without her.

faqs.question: What if the tutor keeps correcting her mid-sentence during speaking practice?
faqs.answer: Raise it immediately, and change tutors if it continues. Constant correction during a practice turn teaches a student to stop taking risks with the language, which is precisely the opposite of what the oral rewards, and it usually shortens her answers rather than improving them. The sound method is to let the turn run, note the patterns, and work on two of them afterwards in a separate part of the session. Tell us in a sentence if it is happening; it is one of the three most common mismatches we see in this subject and a replacement shortlist follows quickly.

faqs.question: Can you tell us what grade to expect by the recording?
faqs.answer: No, and be wary of anyone who does. IB Gram does not guarantee grades and no tutor matched through the platform may promise a specific one. What an honest tutor can give you, after four or five sessions, is a clear description of where your child currently is: how long she can speak with real content, which text types she handles, and which error patterns recur. Your child's own teacher marks the oral and has the evidence base to discuss likely outcomes. Ask the tutor instead which component is most improvable in the time left.

sections.heading: How IB Gram matches an IB DP English B online tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: English B is a language acquisition course, which means the thing being assessed is your child's ability to use the language, not their knowledge about it. That changes what we look for in a tutor. A good English B tutor runs a lesson in which the student does most of the talking, interrupts less than you expect, and keeps a written record of what the student actually said so it can be corrected later. A tutor who lectures beautifully about register and audience for fifty minutes has given your child a lesson in listening, which is one skill out of four.

So the matching conversation is short and specific. We ask which year your child is in, whether the school has entered them at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), which of the course themes the class has covered so far, and which of the three assessment pieces worries you: the Paper 1 writing task, the Paper 2 listening and reading paper, or the individual oral. We also ask the unglamorous question that decides the shortlist: what does your child sound like after thirty seconds of unscripted speech? A student who stalls, switches to Hindi or Marathi for the word they want and then recovers needs a different tutor from one who speaks fluently but writes a formal letter in the register of a text message.

Then we shortlist. You get a small number of profiles rather than a list, because a long list is a way of making the parent do the matching. Each profile says which examination sessions the tutor has prepared students for, whether they have marked English B work against the published criteria, and whether they are offering online, home tuition or both. We are an independent platform, so we have no incentive to push one tutor over another.

sections.heading: Where English B sits in the IB Diploma Programme
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) asks every student to take a language acquisition subject, and in most Mumbai schools that is English B. It runs across the two years of the DP, so a student who starts in DP1 in July is sitting the written papers roughly two academic years later, with the individual oral falling earlier than most families expect. It is examined at Higher Level (HL) and at Standard Level (SL), and the HL course adds a literature element that the SL course does not carry.

Which language course a student takes is not a decision a tutor makes, and it is not a decision you should let a tutor make. Placement sits with the school, working with the family, and it is settled on the basis of the student's whole language profile and the Diploma they are building. Our job once that decision is made is to teach the course the school has entered the student for, well. If you want to reopen the question, the person to talk to is the DP coordinator, not a tutor who has met your child twice.

It is worth being clear about what English B is not. It is not a remedial course, and it is not a sign that anything is wrong with your child's English. A student in Mumbai who moves between Marathi at the building gate, Hindi with cousins, Gujarati or Tamil at home and English in class is multilingual, and that is an asset in a Diploma that rewards exactly this kind of flexibility. The course simply assesses a defined set of skills in English, and those skills are teachable whatever else the student speaks.

Think of this as an English B IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai parents book for a two-year run rather than for one paper. The structure of the assessment, the number of components and anything resembling a weighting or a timing changes on the IB's own revision cycle, so take those details from the current subject guide and your school's coordinator rather than from any tutoring page, including this one.

sections.heading: What does IB DP English B actually assess?
paragraphs: English B is assessed through three pieces of work: a writing task in Paper 1, a listening and reading paper in Paper 2, and an individual oral built on one of the course themes. Those are the only three places a mark comes from, and each one rewards a different habit. Confusing them is the most common reason a hardworking student stalls at the same grade for a year.

Paper 1 asks the student to produce a text for a stated audience and purpose. The marks sit in choosing the right text type and holding its register, not in writing more. A blog post for classmates and a formal letter to a principal can carry the same information and only one of them is correct for a given task. A student who writes a polished essay when the task asked for a speech has lost marks before the examiner reaches the grammar. Paper 2 is two separate disciplines sharing a cover: reading, where the answer has to come from the text in front of the student rather than from what they happen to know about the topic, and listening, which runs at the pace of real speech.

The individual oral is a conversation about a stimulus connected to a course theme, and it is the component where Mumbai students most often underperform relative to how well they speak. Speaking English comfortably and speaking English for an assessed, timed, thematically anchored five minutes are different acts. The student needs language for describing an image, for connecting it to a theme, for conceding a point and for buying themselves a second to think without silence.

The themes the course works through, usually described as identities, experiences, human ingenuity, social organisation and sharing the planet in current guidance, are the frame for the oral and for much of the writing, but your school's scheme of work decides the order and the texts. Ask for it. A tutor who knows which theme the class is on next can prepare the vocabulary your child will need in three weeks instead of revising a theme finished in DP1.
bullets: Paper 1: right text type, right register, right audience, written to the task
Paper 2 reading: the answer comes from the text, not from general knowledge

sections.heading: Which Mumbai areas can an English B tutor cover?
paragraphs: An IB DP English B online tutor in Mumbai can cover every one of them, which is the honest advantage of online for this subject. The pool of tutors who have actually taught English B, as opposed to English A or school English, is small in Mumbai, Maharashtra, and it is not evenly spread. Online removes the geography from the matching problem entirely for the speaking and listening work.

That matters most at the edges of the city. In Navi Mumbai, families in Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar, Panvel and Airoli sit on the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and the Navi Mumbai Metro, and Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway move a tutor between nodes easily enough. Pulling a specialist across the creek from the island city on a weekday evening is a different matter, and even the Atal Setu does not make that a habit a tutor keeps for two years. In Thane, Pokhran Road, Majiwada, Hiranandani Estate and the long Ghodbunder Road stretch out to Kasarvadavali have the same problem in one road: a tutor near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali quickly off-peak and slowly in the evening peak. Online sessions hold their slot in both cases.

The Eastern Suburbs run from Chembur and Govandi up through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, on the Central and Harbour lines, the Eastern Express Highway and the Eastern Freeway, which puts Wadala and Chembur closer to South Mumbai than the map suggests. In the Central Suburbs, Powai and Chandivali hang off JVLR with no station of their own, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and the SCLR carries them to Kurla.

In the Western Suburbs, which run north to south along the Western Line, Metro Lines 1, 2A and 7, the Western Express Highway and the Link Road, matching along the line works and matching across it does not: Khar West to Santacruz is simple, Juhu to Mulund is not. Bandra, Andheri West, Goregaon East, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali and Dahisar all have IB families and uneven tutor supply. sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar an English B student works inside
paragraphs: IB schools across Mumbai run on a July-to-May rhythm for the May examination session, and the English B pressure points are not where parents expect them. The individual oral is usually recorded well before the written papers, which means the speaking work that feels like the soft, optional part of the course becomes urgent first. A DP2 student at Dhirubhai Ambani International School in BKC or at Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu can find the oral window landing in the same weeks as an Internal Assessment (IA) draft in a Group 4 subject and the Extended Essay (EE) deadline.

The quieter trap is DP1. English B in DP1 often feels manageable, because the class is working through themes and the assessment is distant. Students coast, and the gap between comfortable conversational English and assessed English never closes. By the time the first proper mock arrives, the student is being marked on a register they were never taught. The families who get the most out of a tutor start in DP1 precisely because nothing is burning yet.

School mock cycles vary. Some schools run a full mock in the winter of DP2, some split components across two rounds, and some set the oral much earlier than the rest. Families at Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo and the American School of Bombay in BKC are all working to different internal deadlines even when they sit the same external session. Get your school's assessment calendar in writing in the first month of DP1 and give it to the tutor.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page, nor with the International Baccalaureate organisation. We name schools here because the calendar and the expectations they set are the context a Mumbai tutor has to work inside, and for no other reason. We hold no information about any school's internal marking, and we do not pass work between students at the same school.

sections.heading: Online classes, home tuition and hybrid for English B in Mumbai
paragraphs: Home tuition is IB Gram's lead service across Mumbai, and for most subjects a home tutor in the room is the stronger choice. English B is the subject where that is genuinely arguable, because the course is largely about speech and a screen is a reasonable place to produce speech. An IB DP English B online tutor in Mumbai gets things a home tutor cannot get as cheaply: a shared document both people type into while the student is still speaking, so a correction appears where the student can see it rather than in the tutor's notebook; authentic audio and video played on a shared screen at full speed; and a recording of the student's own answer played back thirty seconds later.

Online also suits the individual oral better than almost any other IB component. The oral is a conversation about a stimulus, and a stimulus on a shared screen with a tutor's face in the corner is close to the real thing. A student can practise the oral weekly over video, with the stimulus changing each time, and never once leave the flat.

The counterweight is real and parents should hear it before they book. The written papers are handwritten. A student who has done all their English B writing in a shared document with a spell-checker underlining errors arrives at Paper 1 having never produced a timed handwritten text. So online English B work has to include longhand: the student writes to time on paper, photographs the script and sends it, and the tutor marks the photograph against the published criteria. Any tutor who does not ask for photographed handwritten scripts is teaching a course that is not the one being examined.

Hybrid is what most of our English B families settle into. A weekly English B home tutor session for the handwritten writing, the marking conversation and the sitting-together work, plus a shorter midweek online slot for speaking and listening. In practice that also solves the logistics: one home tuition visit a week is a commitment a tutor keeps for two years, and three are not, especially across Ghodbunder Road or the Western Express Highway in the evening peak. An IB home tutor in Mumbai who is honest about travel will tell you the same thing.

sections.heading: How is an online English B tutor checked before you meet them?
paragraphs: Before a profile reaches you, we check identity, qualifications as stated, and English B teaching or examining experience specifically. The last one is the filter that removes most applicants. Plenty of excellent English teachers in Mumbai have never taught a language acquisition course, and English A experience does not transfer: the criteria are different, the oral is different, and the marking habits are different. We also check that the tutor has marked work against the published criteria rather than giving impressionistic feedback, and we ask for references we can actually reach.

There are checks only you can do, and the trial session is where you do them. Watch the clock: in a good English B lesson the student speaks for most of it. Ask the tutor, after the trial, to name three specific recurring errors they heard, and to say what they would drill first. A tutor who answers with generalities about confidence has not been listening. Ask how they handle the written work, and listen for the word handwritten. Ask for a shared document or folder where your child's own recurring errors and useful phrases are kept and updated, because that file is the single most useful artefact an online English B tutor produces.

Two red lines. A tutor may teach, model and mark a draft, and may say that a paragraph does not do its job. A tutor may never write, redraft or supply any part of a piece your child submits, including a sentence of the oral or a line of a written assignment. If a tutor offers to improve a draft by editing it directly, that is the end of the arrangement. And be wary of any tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, or who talks about a particular university's entry requirement as though they know it; those requirements vary by institution and by year and must be checked at source.

When you search for an IB online tutor in Mumbai you will find a lot of listings and very little verification. Ask any platform, including this one, what exactly it checked and what it did not. Our answer: we check identity, stated qualifications, course-specific experience and references, and we do not observe lessons in your home or on your call. That remains your judgement, and the trial session exists so you can exercise it.

sections.heading: Why speaking time is the whole point of an online English B lesson
paragraphs: Here is the test for an online English B session: add up the minutes your child spoke. If the tutor spoke more, the money bought an explanation of a skill instead of practice at it. Language acquisition does not work by exposition. A student learns to hold a register by producing it, being corrected, and producing it again in the same hour. An IB DP English B online tutor in Mumbai who understands this runs a session that looks almost lazy from the outside: long stretches of the student talking, short interruptions, a lot of typing into a shared file.

The shared document is what makes correction stick. When the student says a sentence that does not work, the tutor types the student's version and the stronger version side by side while the student is still speaking, and the student sees both. Nothing is lost to memory. By the end of the session that document holds a dozen real corrections in the student's own words rather than a worksheet of other people's mistakes, and it is the student's own error list, not a generic one. The same file carries useful phrases: the three ways this student likes to open an oral, the connective they keep reaching for, the hedge they can use to buy a second of thinking time. Over a term it becomes the revision resource that actually gets opened.

Listening is the component online work improves fastest, and only if the material is honest. Textbook listening tracks are recorded slowly and clearly, which is why students score well in class and badly on the paper. Real audio runs faster, overlaps, and contains the half-sentences people actually say. A tutor sharing a screen can play genuine audio and video, stop it mid-clause, ask what the speaker is about to say, and rewind once, which is closer to the exam condition than any slowed recording. The useful habit is one replay, not five.

The oral is the component where video is not a compromise at all. A stimulus on a shared screen, a tutor asking real follow-up questions, a recording the student can watch afterwards: there is very little the room adds. What the room does add is the handwriting, which is why the longhand photograph routine is not optional. A student who writes to time on paper every week and sends the photograph has done the one thing the shared document cannot simulate.

sections.heading: What progress looks like, and what a home tutor or online tutor cannot promise
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see diagnosis, not transformation. A tutor who has done their job can tell you the three errors your child repeats, whether the problem is range or accuracy or register, and which component is weakest. Your child should be speaking more in sessions than in week one and should have a growing error file. A visible grade change in four weeks is not a realistic expectation, and anyone offering one is selling.

At one term, the measurable changes are usually in listening and in text type. Listening responds quickly to honest audio at real speed, often faster than anything else. Choosing the correct text type for a Paper 1 task is a teachable decision rather than a slow-growing skill, so a student who was writing essays for every prompt tends to stop doing that within a term. Accuracy moves more slowly, because it is built from the student's own error list and that takes repetition. Range of expression moves slowest of all.

Over a full exam cycle, the honest claim is that a well-taught student arrives having practised the real thing under real conditions: timed handwritten writing, listening at speed with one replay, and an oral rehearsed enough times that the format holds no surprises. That is what tutoring delivers. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor offers a guaranteed grade in English B, because the mark depends on the paper, the examiner, the day and on work the student does alone. Parents who search for the best IB tutor in Mumbai are usually looking for certainty that nobody can sell them.

When it is not working, say so early. If after three or four sessions your child is not speaking more, or the tutor cannot name specific errors, or the written work is coming back with a tick and a smiley face, that is a mismatch and not a phase. Tell us, and we shortlist again. We would rather change a tutor in week three than have a family quietly stop in month four. There is no penalty and we do not ask you to justify it beyond a sentence.

One term: listening and text-type choice move first, accuracy more slowly

sections.heading: Booking an English B home tutor or online tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: Have four things ready and the first session is worth triple. The school's assessment calendar, including the oral window. The level your child is entered at, Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL). One piece of recent written work, photographed, marks and teacher comments included. And a sentence from your child about which component frightens them, in their own words, because the answer is often not the one the parent expects.

The first session should be a diagnosis. Expect the tutor to ask your child to speak about an unseen image for a minute, to read a short unfamiliar text and answer from it, to listen to a clip at full speed once, and to write a few lines by hand to time. By the end the tutor should be able to tell you what the actual problem is: a student who is fluent but informal needs register work, a student who is accurate but hesitant needs speaking volume, a student who scores badly on reading because they answered from general knowledge needs a text-based discipline drilled.

Expect to be told a plan with an order. English B improvement is sequential, and a tutor who proposes to work on everything at once will finish the term having moved nothing. The usual order is the component with the nearest deadline first, which in DP1 and early DP2 is almost always the oral, then listening, then the writing paper, with the error file running underneath all of it from the first week.

On money, we will not quote you a figure on a web page. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the board, the level, how scarce the subject specialism is, whether the tutor is travelling to you and how long the session runs, and English B is a scarcer specialism than most people assume. An IB home tuition in Mumbai slot that includes travel to Kharghar or Kasarvadavali in the evening peak costs differently from the same hour online. We will tell you what the range depends on and the tutor will quote their own rate before you commit to anything.

Ask for a plan with an order, nearest deadline first

faqs.question: Does online tutoring really work for a language subject like English B?
faqs.answer: For speaking and listening it works unusually well, which is not true of every subject. English B is assessed partly through an individual oral conversation about a stimulus, and a stimulus on a shared screen with a tutor asking real follow-up questions is close to the assessed format. Shared documents let a correction appear in front of the student while they are still speaking, and authentic audio can be played at full speed and stopped mid-sentence. The gap is handwriting: the written papers are done longhand, so any serious online arrangement includes timed writing on paper, photographed and marked.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our building in Kharghar for an evening home tuition slot?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, if the tutor is matched within Navi Mumbai rather than brought across the creek. Navi Mumbai works node to node along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, so a tutor in Nerul or Belapur holds a Kharghar evening slot comfortably for two years. A specialist coming from Bandra or Worli will manage it for a month and then start rescheduling, and the Atal Setu does not change that for a weekday 7pm lesson. For a scarce specialism like English B we will often propose a weekly home classes visit from a nearby tutor plus a midweek online session.

faqs.question: My child speaks English all day at home. Why is English B difficult for her?
faqs.answer: Because the course assesses specific written and spoken skills, not general fluency. A student who speaks English comfortably can still be marked down for writing a blog post in the register of an essay, for answering a reading question from what she knows about the topic rather than from the text, or for running out of language in the middle of an assessed oral. Fluency and assessed performance are different things. The good news is that register, text type and text-based reading are all teachable in a term; they are decisions and habits rather than slow-growing abilities.

faqs.question: What does a single online English B session actually look like?
faqs.answer: Mostly your child talking, with short interruptions and a lot of typing into a shared file. A typical hour: a few minutes on last week's error list, then an unseen image described and discussed as oral practice, then an authentic audio or video clip played at full speed with one replay and questions, then a short piece of writing planned aloud. The tutor types the student's own sentence and a stronger version side by side as it happens. The session ends with the error file updated and one timed handwritten task set for the week.

faqs.question: How do you handle the handwritten papers if lessons are online?
faqs.answer: The student writes to time on paper, photographs the script and sends it before the next session, and the tutor marks the photograph against the published criteria. This is not an optional extra. A student who has produced every piece of English B writing in a shared document with a spell-checker running arrives at the writing paper having never written a timed text by hand, and it shows in the legibility, the planning and the pacing. Ask any online tutor how they deal with longhand work. If the answer is vague, keep looking.

faqs.question: Will a tutor fix my child's written assignment before it goes in?
faqs.answer: No, and you should refuse any tutor who offers to. A tutor may teach a skill, model a strong paragraph, mark a draft against the criteria and tell your child that a section does not do its job. A tutor may not write, redraft or supply any part of a piece your child submits, including a sentence of an oral or a line of written coursework. Work your child did not produce is not their work, and schools are considerably better at spotting it than families expect. The useful version of help is feedback the student then acts on alone.

faqs.question: We live on Ghodbunder Road in Thane. Is the evening commute going to make a home tutor unreliable?
faqs.answer: It is the single biggest cause of cancelled sessions in Thane, so plan around it rather than hoping. Ghodbunder Road out to Kasarvadavali moves fast off-peak and slowly in the evening peak, so a tutor living near Thane station can promise a 6pm slot and deliver it late twice a month. Two fixes work: match a tutor who already lives on your stretch, Majiwada, Hiranandani Estate or Kasarvadavali itself, or take a later weekend home tuition slot and run the midweek speaking session online where traffic is irrelevant.

faqs.question: Should we start in DP1 or wait until DP2?
faqs.answer: DP1, if the goal is English B rather than crisis management. The individual oral window usually falls earlier in the two-year course than parents expect, and DP1 is when the gap between comfortable conversational English and assessed English quietly opens without anyone noticing. A student who starts in DP1 has time for the slow things, accuracy and range of expression, which do not respond to a six-week push. Starting in DP2 still helps, because listening and text-type choice move quickly, but the slowest-moving marks are the ones you lose.

faqs.question: How much does an IB English B tutor cost in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: We do not publish a figure, because any number on a page is either wrong or an anchor. The rate depends on the level, on how scarce the subject specialism is, on session length, on whether the tutor is travelling to your home, and on where in the city you are. English B is scarcer than Maths or Physics, because most English teachers in Mumbai have taught literature courses rather than a language acquisition course. An online slot and a home tuition slot with an hour of evening travel are priced differently. The tutor quotes directly and you agree it before the trial.

faqs.question: What if there is no progress after a month?
faqs.answer: Tell us in week three, not month four. At four weeks you should not expect a grade change, but you should expect a diagnosis: the tutor should be able to name three errors your child repeats, say whether the problem is range, accuracy or register, and show you an error file that has grown. If none of that exists, it is a mismatch rather than a slow start, and we shortlist again at no cost and without asking you to justify it. Changing a tutor early is normal and costs far less than waiting.

faqs.question: Is English B a sign that my child's English is weak?
faqs.answer: No. English B is the language acquisition subject in the Diploma, and students are placed on it for all sorts of reasons connected to their whole language profile and the Diploma they are building. A Mumbai student who moves between Marathi, Hindi, Gujarati or Tamil and English through a single day is multilingual, and that flexibility is an asset in the IB. Which language course a student takes is decided by the school with the family, and if you want to discuss it the DP coordinator is the right person, not a tutor. Our job is to teach the course your child is entered for.

faqs.question: Can we switch between online sessions and home classes partway through the year?
faqs.answer: Yes, and most families end up doing exactly that. A common pattern is online through the oral preparation period, when speaking practice and shared screens matter most, then a weekly home tutor visit in the months before the written papers, when timed handwritten work and sitting-together marking conversations matter more. Tell the tutor at the start that the mode may change so the slot is protected either way. The only thing to avoid is switching mode and tutor at once in the term before the exams, which costs you the relationship and the error file together.

sections.heading: How IB Gram shortlists an IB DP English B private tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: The intake conversation for English B is different from every other subject we match, because half the parents who call are not really asking for tutoring. They are asking whether their child is on the right course. That is a fair question and it deserves a straight answer rather than a sales pitch: the course a student takes is decided by the school together with the family, on the basis of the student's whole language profile and the Diploma they are building, and nobody at a tutoring platform is in a position to overrule it. What we can do is describe the considerations honestly, so that you walk into the coordinator's office knowing what to ask.

So we start by separating the two cases. A student struggling with English B needs a specialist who teaches the components. A student bored by English B needs something else entirely: either enrichment that goes beyond the syllabus while they finish the course they are entered for, or a conversation with the school inside whatever window it allows for changes. Matching a bored student with a patient remedial tutor is a waste of a year, and it happens constantly.

After that, the ordinary questions. The level, Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), since the HL course carries a literature element the SL course does not. The other language in the Diploma, because a student carrying two demanding language subjects has a workload shape that affects scheduling. Your area, because an English B home tutor who cannot hold a weekday evening slot across the Western Express Highway is not a match. And your availability, which is the constraint parents under-report and then discover in week three.

1. A call in which we establish whether this is a difficulty problem, a stretch problem or a placement question. 2. If it is a placement question, we tell you what to ask the Diploma Programme coordinator and when. 3. Two or three verified one-to-one profiles matched to the actual problem and your area. 4. A paid trial that ends with the tutor describing what they found. 5. A standing slot, or a different tutor at no cost and no argument.

sections.heading: English B and English A: what sits behind a placement decision
paragraphs: In the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), a student takes a studies-in-language-and-literature subject and a language acquisition subject. In most Mumbai IB schools, English appears in one of those two slots: either as an English A course, studied as literature or as language and literature, or as English B, the language acquisition course. The courses are not a ladder with one above the other. They ask for different things. An A course asks a student to analyse literary and non-literary texts and write about them critically. English B asks a student to use the language accurately and appropriately across the Paper 1 writing task, the Paper 2 listening and reading paper and an individual oral.

The considerations schools weigh are reasonably consistent: how the student has been taught in English until now, what their other language in the Diploma is and how strong it is, which course gives the Diploma a coherent shape, and what the student is genuinely able to produce in writing rather than in conversation. Note that last one. Spoken fluency and the ability to write a critical commentary are separate capacities, and a student can have an abundance of the first with no training in the second.

The decision belongs to the school and the family, and it belongs there for good reasons: the school has seen the student's written work across years, knows the timetable constraints and knows what each course demands in practice. A tutor who has met your child twice does not. We will describe the considerations; we will not tell you which course your child should be on, and you should be sceptical of anyone who does after a single session.

A word on universities, because it drives more placement anxiety than anything else. Entry requirements vary by institution, by country, by course and by year, and they change. There is no general rule we can responsibly give you about how any particular language course is treated. Check the requirement on the admitting university's own published page for the year your child will apply, and ask your school's counsellor to confirm it. An English B IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai parents hire is not a source for admissions criteria, and neither is this page.
bullets: An A course and English B ask for different skills, not different amounts of ability
Schools weigh prior schooling, the other Diploma language and written output

sections.heading: What is actually assessed in English B, at HL and at SL?
paragraphs: Three components carry the marks: the Paper 1 writing task, the Paper 2 listening and reading paper, and the individual oral built on a course theme. Both Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) students meet all three. The visible structural difference is that the HL course includes a literature element the SL course does not, which changes the reading a student does and the range of expression expected of them.

Underneath that, the difference HL students feel is bar height rather than new skills. The same Paper 1 decision, choosing a text type and holding its register for a stated audience, is marked against a more demanding expectation. The same reading discipline, answering from the passage rather than from what you happen to know, is tested on denser texts. The oral asks for more sustained development of an idea. A student who is coping comfortably at SL is not automatically ready for HL, and a student finding HL heavy is not necessarily in the wrong subject; those are two different conversations with the school.

The literature element at HL is worth understanding before you panic about it. It is reading in the target language as part of a language acquisition course, not a literature course in disguise, and the demand is on comprehension, discussion and the language a student can produce about what they have read. Families sometimes assume it makes HL English B equivalent to an A course. It does not, and nobody should make a placement argument on that basis.

For both levels, ask the school for the scheme of work and the theme order. Knowing which course theme the class takes next lets a private tutor build vocabulary and ideas the student will use in three weeks rather than revising a theme finished last year. And take the component structure, the order of assessment and anything that looks like a length or timing guideline from the current subject guide and the Diploma Programme coordinator, because the IB revises guides on its own cycle and a figure quoted on a tutoring site has no shelf life.
bullets: Paper 1 writing task, Paper 2 listening and reading, individual oral at both levels
Higher Level (HL) adds a literature element and raises the expected range
HL English B is not a substitute for a Group 1 literature course
Comfortable at SL does not automatically mean ready for HL
