sections.heading: Is a home tutor or an online tutor better for Global Politics in Mumbai?
paragraphs: For most families a home tutor wins on consistency and an online tutor wins on availability, and for this subject the deciding factor is usually how scarce the specialist pool is near you. Home tuition gives you a teenager who cannot drift, a table covered in marked scripts, and a tutor who notices when a student is reciting an argument they do not understand. It is the better default where a Diploma Programme Global Politics specialist genuinely lives within reach of your area.

Online suits this subject better than it suits laboratory sciences, and in Global Politics it has one specific advantage: discussion. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can share a source extract, type a counter-argument into a shared document while the student is still talking, and have the student rewrite a paragraph in real time with both versions visible. That is harder to do neatly on paper. Online also makes short, frequent sessions practical, which is what a student in the November crush actually needs rather than one long weekly block.

Hybrid is what most families end up with and it works best when it is chosen rather than stumbled into. Keep the weekly session at home for essay work and the slow business of concept teaching, and add online sessions for source practice and quick feedback on a draft paragraph. An IB home tutor in Mumbai who also offers short online sessions is worth more in DP2 than two separate tutors, because feedback loses value when the person giving it has not seen last week's script.

The honest costs: a travelling tutor cancels more in the monsoon, will not take an early morning slot across the city, and prices the journey in. An online tutor is easy to reschedule and easy for a tired student to attend at half attention with the camera off and a phone in hand. Neither mode fixes a student who will not write. Tell us which of those two failure modes you can actually manage and we will match for it rather than recommending whichever is easier to staff.

sections.heading: What should you ask a Global Politics tutor before the first session?
paragraphs: Ask four questions and the answers will separate a Diploma Programme specialist from a well-read generalist in about five minutes. Which key concepts does the current course use, and how would you teach the difference between power and legitimacy? Have you marked Paper 1 source questions to the published criteria? Have you supervised an engagement report through to submission? And how do you handle a student whose political views differ from your own? IB Gram checks identity, qualifications and references before any profile is shown, but these four answers are yours to judge.

That last question is the one that matters most on this page. A tutor's job in Global Politics is to teach the analysis and to keep their own politics entirely out of the room. A good answer sounds administrative rather than principled: they will ask the student to state the strongest version of the view they are attacking, they will mark the argument and not the conclusion, and they will tell the student when an essay has substituted conviction for evidence regardless of which direction the conviction runs. A tutor who instead tells you which views are correct is a liability in this subject, whatever you think of the views.

Verification on the platform covers government photo identification, evidence of the qualifications claimed and references that can actually be contacted. What it cannot cover is availability honesty and teaching fit, so check those yourself. Ask whether the tutor can hold your slot for a full term, not for this month, and ask for a sample of written feedback on a real script with the student's name removed. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents retain for both Diploma years is almost always one whose written feedback was specific from week one.

Be wary of a tutor who promises a specific grade, quotes a success rate, or claims examiner status without naming the board and the years. Treat any offer to draft the engagement report or any part of it as disqualifying rather than helpful, because the IB treats that as malpractice and the consequences land on the student. An IB DP global politics tutor in Mumbai should be comfortable saying out loud that they will comment on a draft the student wrote and will not write a line of it themselves.
bullets: Ask how they would teach the difference between power and legitimacy.
Ask whether they have marked source questions to the published criteria.

sections.heading: Why does a strongly held opinion score so badly?
paragraphs: Because the mark scheme is not asking what the student thinks. It is asking whether the student can analyse competing perspectives with evidence, use the course concepts precisely, and reach a judgement that survives the obvious objection. A paragraph of forceful conviction with one example attached demonstrates none of those things. This is the single hardest idea to land with a bright DP1 student, and it is why the most argumentative students in a class are often not the highest scoring. They are performing a debate, and the examination is asking for an analysis.

The practical repair has three parts. First, attribution: every claim in an essay belongs to somebody, and writing whose view it is turns an assertion into evidence. A student who writes that a particular group of states regards a trade restriction as a legitimate exercise of sovereignty, while affected exporters regard the same measure as coercion, has written analysis. A student who writes that the restriction is unjust has written an opinion. The facts can be identical. Second, steel-manning: the student states the opposing perspective in its strongest, most sympathetic form before answering it, which both earns the counter-argument marks and forces genuine thought. Third, concept discipline, so that the argument is carried by legitimacy, interdependence or power rather than by adjectives.

Representing a view you disagree with accurately is a trainable skill and the sessions that teach it are uncomfortable by design. A tutor will hand the student a position they reject and ask for the best possible case for it, with no commentary and no hedging, then mark that case on accuracy and strength alone. Students find this harder than any essay plan. It is also the fastest route out of the middle bands, because an examiner reading a fairly stated counter-case can see analysis rather than advocacy. The tutor stays silent on their own view throughout, which is not neutrality as a pose but a condition of the exercise working.

Examples are the other half of the problem. A Global Politics tutor in Mumbai will usually find that a student has four favourite examples deployed as applause lines rather than as evidence. An example earns marks when it does analytical work: it specifies which actor, which concept, what the competing readings of the same event are, and what it demonstrates about the question actually asked. Prefer generic framings while learning the technique, such as a state restricting an export or an international organisation issuing a resolution with no enforcement mechanism, because they strip out the emotional pull and leave the structure visible. Once the structure is reliable, the student can apply it to whatever material their school teaches.
bullets: Marks come from analysing competing perspectives, not from holding the right view.

sections.heading: Honest expectations, and the limits of what tutoring changes
paragraphs: Four weeks in, look for changes in how work is produced rather than in marks. The student should be planning before writing, naming the command term out loud, and attributing claims instead of asserting them. A paragraph should contain somebody else's view stated fairly. None of this will have moved a grade yet and expecting it to is how families conclude tutoring has failed just as it starts working. Ask to see one marked piece of written feedback per fortnight and read it yourself.

By the end of a term the gains should be visible in a specific component. If the work was source handling, Paper 1 style questions should look different on the last school assessment. If it was essay structure, the counter-argument paragraph should exist and be competent. Expect unevenness: students often improve markedly on essays while source comparison stays flat, because attention went to one and not the other. That is a scheduling question to raise with the tutor, not evidence of a bad match.

Over a full examination cycle, a student who writes practice answers between sessions and acts on the feedback can move meaningfully. A student who attends and writes nothing will not, and no arrangement of sessions changes that. We do not guarantee grades, we will not predict one, and an IB tutor Mumbai parents trust is one who tells you in week two that the plan requires written work the student has so far not been doing. The honest statement is that tutoring improves the quality of practice; it does not replace it.

When a match is not working, the signals are consistent: no written feedback, the tutor talking for most of the hour, or a student who has stopped bringing scripts. Say so in week four rather than in March. Message IB Gram with a sentence or two on what went wrong and we shortlist again in the same area, recording the reason so the next profile differs where it counts. Most mismatches are about pace, personality or scheduling rather than competence, and replacing a tutor is a routine conversation here.
bullets: Four weeks: planning before writing, command terms named, claims attributed.
One term: visible movement on the component the tutor was asked to fix.
One exam cycle: real movement, but only with written work between sessions.
Read the written feedback yourself at least once a fortnight.

Expect to hear that an essay you thought was strong was advocacy rather than analysis. A pleasant first session that produces no written work and no disagreement has told you nothing worth paying for.

faqs.question: My child debates well but gets mid-band marks. What is going wrong?
faqs.answer: Almost always the same three things. The essay states a position without attributing the competing views to anyone, so assertion is doing the work that evidence should do. The counter-argument is either missing or built as a straw man, which loses marks twice. And the course concepts are being used as ordinary English rather than as analytical tools, so the examiner cannot see analysis taking place. All three are trainable, and a diagnostic session on a real marked script will usually identify which of them is costing the most. Confident students often need the least content work and the most structural work.

faqs.question: Will a tutor push their own political views on my child?
faqs.answer: No, and any tutor who does is the wrong tutor for this subject. The brief on IB Gram is explicit: teach the analysis, mark the argument rather than the conclusion, and keep personal politics out of the session entirely. In practice that means the tutor will ask your child to state opposing perspectives fairly, will challenge an unevidenced claim regardless of which direction it points, and will not offer their own verdict on any contested issue. If a tutor ever does editorialise, tell us and we will shortlist again. The examination rewards fair analysis, so a tutor with an agenda is actively unhelpful.

faqs.question: How does a tutor teach the difference between power and legitimacy?
faqs.answer: By making a student analyse the same material twice. A tutor will take a neutral framing, such as a government introducing a trade restriction, and ask what a power analysis says about who can act and who must respond, then ask separately whether the action is accepted as rightful and by whom. The student quickly sees that an actor can have one and not the other, which is the insight the course is testing. The exercise is repeated across different thematic material until the student reaches for the right concept without prompting. Expect two or three sessions on this alone early in DP1.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to Thane or Navi Mumbai for an evening home session?
faqs.answer: Yes where a specialist already lives in that area, which is how we try to match. Within Thane a tutor near the station reaches Vartak Nagar or Manpada easily, while Kolshet, Owale and the Ghodbunder Road stretch past Hiranandani Estate are much slower after six, so weekend or early evening slots hold better. In Navi Mumbai we match node to node across Airoli, Ghansoli, Kopar Khairane, Seawoods and Panvel. Because Global Politics is a thin subject pool, we will tell you honestly if no local specialist exists and recommend online rather than booking a long commute that collapses by week four.

faqs.question: What do we need to arrange at the society gate and in the building?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once rather than treating them as a new visitor each week. Ask your society office whether they issue a standing weekly entry or a recurring service-provider pass, then send the tutor's name, identification number and the fixed day and time before the first session. Tutors on the platform expect to share photo identification for the register. Agree where the car or two-wheeler goes, because a parking dispute at the gate is the most common reason a first session begins late. Also pick a room where a parent is within earshot but not in the conversation, which suits this subject particularly.

faqs.question: Does the tutor help with the engagement activity and report?
faqs.answer: A tutor teaches the framework, questions the choice of political issue and comments on a draft the student has written. They do not write, redraft or supply any part of it, and the practical and safety constraints around the activity are the school's to set. On this page the useful help is upstream: making sure the issue is narrow enough to analyse and that the student can see which concepts will frame the eventual report. The report itself has a fuller treatment on the dedicated page for it, because it deserves more room than a single answer here can give it.

faqs.question: Is Higher Level Global Politics much harder than Standard Level?
faqs.answer: It is more work and a different kind of work. Higher Level adds a researched extension on global political challenges, presented for assessment, which demands sustained independent reading and concept precision rather than extra memorisation. Students who enjoy following a question into depth usually find it rewarding. Students who are already carrying two writing-heavy Higher Level subjects should think carefully about the total load across November to January. Ask the coordinator for the current format before deciding, and check any university course requirement on that university's own admissions pages for the relevant entry year rather than relying on anyone's recollection.

faqs.question: Which months should we start in to make a real difference?
faqs.answer: June to October of DP1 is the cheapest and most effective window, because that is when concept precision and essay structure can be built properly rather than patched. The next best is immediately after DP1 final assessments, when there is still a full year to apply the technique. Starting in January of DP2 still helps, but the work narrows to timed practice, source handling and the two or three recurring errors that are costing the most marks. Starting in March is exam craft only. We will tell you plainly which of those four conversations you are having.

faqs.question: What if we are not happy with the tutor after a month?
faqs.answer: Message us in week four with one or two sentences on what went wrong. The reasons that justify a change are concrete: no written feedback on any script, the tutor talking through most of the hour, repeated rescheduling, or no agreed plan naming a component. We shortlist again from the same area and record the reason so the next profile differs where it matters rather than being simply another name. Most mismatches are about pace, personality or timing rather than subject knowledge, and nobody here treats a replacement request as a complaint.

faqs.question: Does online tuition work for a discussion-heavy subject like this?
faqs.answer: Better than for most subjects. Sharing a source extract, typing a counter-argument into a document while the student is still speaking and rewriting a paragraph with both versions side by side all work cleanly online, and short frequent sessions are easier to arrange than they are in person. What online loses is attention: a tired DP2 student can attend at half strength with the camera off. The usual compromise is a weekly session at home for essay work plus online sessions for source practice and quick draft feedback, with the same tutor across both.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee my child will improve before the May exams?
faqs.answer: No, we do not guarantee grades and we will not predict one. What we can describe is the realistic mechanism: an IB DP global politics tutor in Mumbai improves the quality of the practice a student does, marks it honestly against the published criteria, and names the recurring errors so they stop recurring. A student who writes between sessions and acts on feedback usually moves. A student who attends and writes nothing usually does not. Any tutor who offers you a specific grade is telling you something they cannot know, and we do not allow it on the platform.

sections.heading: Higher Level and Standard Level Hindi A: what changes in the written work
paragraphs: Hindi A is part of the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) group covering studies in language and literature, taught in Hindi as a literature course rather than as language acquisition. It runs across Years 1 and 2 of the Diploma at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL). The written assessment is built on a Paper 1 guided analysis of unseen material and a Paper 2 comparative essay on works the class has studied, alongside the individual oral and, at Higher Level, an additional piece of written work. Which course route and level your child takes was decided by the school with your family at placement.

What the level changes, in practice, is the amount of sustained writing. A Higher Level student writes more, about more works, and has to hold an argument over a longer stretch of Hindi prose without the quality thinning. A Standard Level student has fewer plates spinning and the same standard of analysis applied to what they do write. Neither is a soft option, and the idea that one of them is a quiet route to a better total is the misunderstanding that produces the worst scripts.

The structural detail is not something to take from a tutoring page. Numbers of works, the form of the guiding question on the unseen paper, and the exact wording of the assessment criteria are revised on the IB's subject guide cycle, so read the current guide and ask the DP coordinator. A Hindi A IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families engage should be working from the criteria your child will actually be marked against, printed and on the table, not from a remembered version.

For exam-focused home tuition there is one more thing worth establishing early. Ask the school how its internal marking relates to the published criteria, and ask for a marked script rather than a grade. A number out of a total tells a tutor nothing. The examiner's reasoning, or the teacher's, is the whole diagnostic.

sections.heading: What does Paper 1 guided analysis ask a Hindi A student to do?
paragraphs: Paper 1 puts a passage of Hindi the student has never seen in front of them, with a guiding question, and asks for an analysis of how the passage works. Not what it says. The mark rests on an argument about the text supported by close reading of its language and structure, written in formal Hindi. Everything the student knows about the set works is irrelevant here, which is exactly why it unsettles strong readers.

The planning minutes decide this paper, and almost nobody uses them. A student who starts writing in the first minute writes a running commentary: the first line does this, then the poet says that, then there is a metaphor. A student who reads the passage twice, marks three or four places where the language is visibly doing something, and asks what connects them, has an argument before the first sentence. The guiding question is a lever for that, not a checklist item. It points at a feature, and the job is to decide what that feature achieves across the whole passage.

The failure mode in Hindi A is identical to the one in every language A: listing devices. A script that names a figure of speech, locates it, and moves on has described the furniture. The criteria reward the move after that. Why this image and not an obvious alternative; what the repetition does to the reader's sense of the speaker; how a shift in the sentence rhythm matches a shift in the argument. One well-chosen feature followed three ways through a passage beats six features identified and abandoned.

Quoting is the mechanical habit that carries it. Short quotations, embedded inside the student's own Hindi sentence, analysed immediately. Long block quotations eat time, eat space and prove nothing; a quoted half-line with two sentences of reasoning after it proves everything. Home tuition is the right setting for drilling this, because a tutor can stop a student mid-paragraph and ask what the quotation is doing there, which is a question that only works out loud and only on the student's own writing.
bullets: Read twice, mark three or four live features, then find the connection
Use the guiding question as a lever into an argument, not a checklist

sections.heading: Mock examinations in Mumbai schools, and how to use the scripts
paragraphs: Mock examinations are the most wasted resource in the Mumbai Diploma calendar. Students at Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, Bombay International School at Babulnath, JBCN International School, Parel, Witty International School in Chembur, NES International School in Mulund West and D.Y. The grade gets discussed at home for twenty minutes. The reasoning on the page gets read by nobody.

A mock script is the only document that shows a Hindi A student's writing under exactly the conditions that will decide the grade: cold passage, clock running, hand cramping, no dictionary. It records how long the student spent before writing, whether the argument held to the last paragraph or dissolved into summary, and whether handwriting stayed legible once the hand tired. The first job of home tuition after a mock is to sit with that script and the published criteria and work out which of those four things went wrong, in that order.

The calendar then dictates the plan. DP2 at a Mumbai school compresses mocks, Extended Essay (EE) submission, the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay and internal deadlines for every subject into the same stretch, with Diwali and the winter break inside it. Hindi A is usually the smallest cohort in the year, so it is the subject whose practice slides first. The counter is a fixed weekly home tuition slot booked before that period rather than inside it, with one timed paper a fortnight from the start of DP2 rather than a burst of six in March.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of the schools named here or with the International Baccalaureate organisation. We name them because their calendars and their internal marking practices are what a Mumbai family is actually planning around, and because asking your school for the marked script rather than the mark is the most useful request a parent can make all year.

sections.heading: Is home tuition better than online for Hindi A exam practice?
paragraphs: For written practice, yes, and the reason is physical. The papers are produced by hand, so the useful session involves paper, a pen, a clock on the table and someone watching how the student writes. An IB home tutor in Mumbai sees the pause before the pen moves, the crossing out, the moment the handwriting starts to deteriorate in the third paragraph. None of that reaches a camera.

IB DP Hindi A home tuition in Mumbai also solves the practical half of exam preparation. The set works are on the shelf, the mock scripts are in the folder, and the student cannot claim the file is on another device. A tutor can set a timed paragraph, leave the room for the duration, come back and mark it with the student present, which is a cycle that takes one home session and three online sessions with uploads in between. Hindi A home classes Mumbai families book for DP2 are usually structured exactly that way: half the session writing, half the session marking.

The trade-offs are real. An IB online tutor in Mumbai draws from a far wider pool, and in a subject this thin that matters; a family in Kharghar or Dahisar East may have no in-person option worth taking. Online is also more resilient in the monsoon and easier to shrink to twenty minutes during mock week. What it costs is the handwriting loop: everything written by hand has to be photographed, uploaded and marked at a remove, and in practice the handwritten work is the first thing to stop happening.

The arrangement most of our exam-focused students settle into is weekly IB home tuition in Mumbai with online sessions added in the weeks before the written session, when frequency matters more than format. Booking the online fallback at the start of the match rather than after the first washed-out Tuesday is the small administrative step that keeps the rhythm intact.

sections.heading: How do we check a Hindi A tutor who will be marking exam scripts?
paragraphs: Every tutor has had identity and contact details verified, has produced a degree and any teaching qualification, and has given references or a record of IB teaching. For exam-focused Hindi A work we ask for one more thing: a marked sample. We send a short piece of student writing and ask the tutor to mark it against the published criteria. What we are reading is not the mark they give. It is whether their comments point at the student's own sentences and say what to do differently, or whether they rewrite the paragraph in better Hindi and award a number.

Your own checks should go the same way. Ask the tutor to mark one page of your child's work in front of you. A tutor who has marked Hindi A scripts will talk in the language of the criteria and will say where the argument stopped being an argument. Ask them what they do when a student has memorised an essay on a set work. Ask which of your school's set works they have taught, by title. A Hindi A tutor in Mumbai who answers all three with warm generalities is a conversationalist, not a marker.

The authorship boundary applies at every stage of exam preparation. A tutor may teach, set timed work, question an argument until it holds, and mark a draft or a script against the criteria, telling a student plainly that a paragraph summarises where it should analyse. A tutor may not write, redraft or supply any part of what the student submits, including the written task Higher Level students produce and anything that forms part of the individual oral. The marking should leave the student with work to do, not with a better version to copy.

Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade or quotes the score your child will reach by the session. We do not guarantee grades and no honest marker does; what is on offer is a method, a standard applied consistently, and attendance. The best IB tutor in Mumbai for an exam-anxious student is often the one whose marking is strictest in October and calmest in April.
bullets: A marked sample is requested before any Hindi A tutor is shortlisted
Read the comments, not the mark: do they point at the student's sentences
Ask the tutor to mark one page of your child's work in front of you

sections.heading: The Paper 2 comparative essay: a thesis, not a prepared answer
paragraphs: The single most damaging habit in Hindi A is the prepared essay. A student writes a strong piece on two set works during the year, learns it, and reproduces it in the examination with a sentence bolted on at each end to gesture at the question in front of them. Examiners see it constantly and it scores badly, because the criteria reward a response to the question asked. A beautifully written essay about something else is still about something else.

What the paper actually wants is a thesis that answers the given question and is sustained across both works. The construction is unglamorous. Read the question and underline the term doing the work. Decide what your answer to it is, in one sentence, before planning anything. Then ask which moments in each work support that answer and which complicate it, because an essay that acknowledges the awkward evidence and still holds its line reads as thinking rather than retrieval. Only then does the plan get written, and the plan is a sequence of claims, each attached to a specific passage.

Comparison is the part most often faked. Two paragraphs about the first novel followed by two about the second, with the word similarly inserted, is not comparison; it is two essays sharing a staple. The structure that works is one claim at a time, tested against both works inside the same paragraph, with the differences made to matter: both writers put a silence at the centre of the family, but one treats it as inheritance and the other as choice. That sentence is worth more than a page of parallel description.

Then the writing itself, which in Hindi A means formal written Hindi produced at speed and remaining legible. These are trainable and they train slowly. Write in proportion to where the criteria place the weight, which means not spending the strongest half-hour on context nobody asked for. Keep quotations short so analysis has room. Where a set work touches religion, caste or politics, say how the text has been read differently and argue a position from the evidence on the page, rather than reproducing a verdict learned from a guide; examiners can tell the difference, and the former is what the criteria describe. And rehearse the last paragraph as deliberately as the first, because that is where a tiring hand and a thinning argument usually arrive together.
bullets: Answer the question asked; a prepared essay bolted on scores badly
One sentence of thesis before any plan gets written
Compare inside the paragraph, one claim tested against both works
Make differences matter instead of listing parallel descriptions
On contested texts, show how readings differ and argue from evidence

sections.heading: What four weeks, one term and one exam cycle of home tuition change in Mumbai
paragraphs: Four weeks of weekly home tuition should produce two visible changes, and neither is a grade. The first is that the student plans before writing: there are marks on the question paper, three or four features circled in the passage, a thesis sentence at the top of the page. The second is that quotations have shrunk and the analysis after them has grown. If after four weeks the practice paragraphs still open with a summary of the passage, the method is not landing, and that is a conversation to have now rather than in March.

A term in, the markers get harder and more honest. The student should be able to write an analytical paragraph in formal Hindi, by hand, against a clock, without the quality collapsing in the final lines. They should be able to look at their own script beside the published criteria and say where it fell short, which is the skill that makes every later practice paper self-correcting. Internal grades may lag; a Hindi A cohort in a Mumbai school can be small enough that marks move in big steps, so judge the scripts rather than the report card.

Over a full cycle, the gains that survive are pace, legibility, and the habit of arguing rather than listing. Those three are also the ones nobody can install in the final month, which is the argument for starting in DP1 rather than after the DP2 mock. The limits deserve saying plainly: a tutor cannot read the set works on a student's behalf, cannot write in the examination room, and cannot create fluency in literary Hindi in six weeks for a student who has avoided reading for two years. We do not guarantee grades, and a tutor who suggests otherwise after seeing one script is guessing.

When a match is not working, the signs in exam-focused tuition are specific: no timed writing happening, marking that consists of corrections rather than comments, scripts that improve while the student cannot explain why. Tell us what you are seeing and we will ask the tutor for their read. If the problem is the subject rather than the schedule, we replace the tutor from the same shortlist and pass on the marked scripts so the new tutor starts with the evidence instead of a fresh diagnosis.
bullets: Four weeks: visible planning on the paper, shorter quotations, longer analysis
One term: a timed paragraph in formal Hindi that holds to the last line
One term: the student can mark their own script against the criteria
One cycle: pace, legibility and argument, none installable in a month
Warning signs: no timed writing, corrections instead of comments

sections.heading: Your first Hindi A home tuition session in Mumbai: bring a marked script
paragraphs: Four things to have ready. The most recent marked script or written assignment, with the teacher's comments intact. The set works list, with editions if the school specified them. The published assessment criteria, printed, because a session spent squinting at a phone is a wasted session. And one honest sentence about the difficulty: planning, argument, formal register, handwriting speed, or simply not having finished one of the books.

The session itself runs backwards from the script. The tutor will read it with your child, find the exact sentence where the argument turned into description, and then set a short timed task on a fresh passage to see whether the same thing happens twice. Expect the hour to be uncomfortable and expect your child to write something by hand in it. Afterwards you should receive a short written read: which paper is the weak one, what the specific habit is, and what the next four sessions will do about it.

Then the practical arrangements. A standing weekly slot in a room with a table and a door, with a parent in the flat rather than in the room, and a clock the student can see. A fortnightly timed paper built into the plan from the start. An agreed online fallback for monsoon evenings. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels, session length and how often you book; Hindi A is scarce and marking takes the tutor time outside the session, so ask any candidate whether marking of work set between sessions is included before you compare one quote with another.
bullets: Bring the marked script, the set works list and printed criteria
Expect timed handwriting in the first session, not a lecture
Ask whether marking between sessions is included in the rate
Book a standing weekly slot and a fortnightly timed paper
Agree the monsoon online fallback on day one

faqs.question: How soon should exam-focused home tuition start?
faqs.answer: Early in DP1 if you have the choice, and immediately after the first mock if you do not. IB DP Hindi A home tuition in Mumbai aimed at the written papers works on habits, and habits move slowly: planning before writing, short quotations, formal register under time pressure, legible handwriting in the final paragraph. Six weeks before the session is enough to polish and not enough to rebuild. Families who start in DP1 use fewer sessions overall, because the work is correcting a habit rather than unpicking two years of a settled one.

faqs.question: My child knows the texts but scores poorly. What is going wrong?
faqs.answer: Nine times out of ten it is description instead of argument. The script retells what happens, names a few figures of speech, and never commits to a claim the examiner can agree or disagree with. Knowing the text is the raw material; the marks sit in what the student does with it. The fix is mechanical and slow: one thesis sentence before planning, one claim per paragraph, a short quotation, then two sentences explaining what that quotation does. A tutor should be able to show you the exact line in a marked script where this breaks.

faqs.question: Is it worth memorising an essay on the set works before the exam?
faqs.answer: No, and it is actively risky. A prepared essay reproduced regardless of the question scores badly, because the criteria reward a response to the question in front of the student. What is worth preparing is the material underneath an essay: a bank of passages from each set work with notes on what they do, a clear sense of each writer's methods, and practice turning that material into different arguments. A student who has written five different answers on the same two works is prepared. A student with one memorised answer is exposed.

faqs.question: How is the unseen Paper 1 passage practised at home?
faqs.answer: With unfamiliar passages, a clock and no discussion beforehand. The tutor brings a passage of literary Hindi the student has not seen, the student reads and plans under timed conditions, writes, and only then do they talk. Doing it the other way round, discussing the passage and then writing, feels more productive and teaches almost nothing, because the hard part is the cold start. Over a term the student should go from writing immediately to reading twice and marking the passage before the pen moves.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our building in Powai for an evening session?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg, Ghatkopar or within Powai and Chandivali itself. Powai has no railway station of its own, so the realistic question is the JVLR at the hour you want. A 6pm start from Andheri East is a different proposition from a 7.30pm start, and tutors will often prefer the later slot for exactly that reason. Tell us the building and the preferred time together at matching, because a tutor who agrees to an unworkable hour in September will be asking to move it by November.

faqs.question: Does someone need to be at home during home tuition sessions?
faqs.answer: An adult should be in the flat, though not in the room. There are practical reasons, starting with gate access, and a sensible safeguarding reason for both the tutor and the student. Sitting in on the session is different and generally unhelpful for exam work: a student writing a timed paragraph with a parent watching writes for the parent. What is worth doing is reading the tutor's written feedback each month and keeping the marked scripts together in one folder, because that folder is the revision resource in the final term.

faqs.question: What do home tuition fees for Hindi A depend on?
faqs.answer: Level, subject scarcity, travel distance, session length and frequency, and whether marking between sessions is included. Hindi A is a thinner market in Mumbai than the common DP subjects, which moves rates up, and marking a timed paper properly takes a tutor real time outside the hour you are paying for. Compare quotes on that basis rather than on the hourly figure alone. We do not publish a price list, because an honest range for Nerul and an honest range for Peddar Road are not the same range.

faqs.question: How much timed writing should a student do each week?
faqs.answer: Less than families expect, more often than they manage. One timed analytical paragraph a week and one full timed paper a fortnight from early DP2 is a workable rhythm for most students, and it beats three papers crammed into the week before a mock. The point of frequency is stamina and pace, both of which build gradually. What matters more than volume is that every timed piece is marked against the criteria and that the student rewrites one paragraph of it by hand afterwards.

faqs.question: Our society gate needs a pass for every visitor. Does that affect weekly sessions?
faqs.answer: It is routine once it is set up properly. Societies in Chembur, Powai, Mulund West and along Palm Beach Road normally allow standing entry for a regular tutor once the flat owner registers the name and the weekly timing with the committee or the gate app. Tell us at matching if your building requires photo identification, a police verification copy or a pre-registered vehicle, because that changes which tutors can keep a fixed evening slot. Ten minutes lost at the gate is ten minutes off a timed paper.

faqs.question: Can one tutor handle both the written papers and the oral?
faqs.answer: Usually, and it is the better arrangement. The close reading that produces a strong Paper 1 script is the same close reading the individual oral needs, so a tutor who sees both halves can stop the student building two separate habits. The caution is bandwidth near the oral window, when preparation tends to crowd out written practice entirely. Agree in advance that the fortnightly timed paper continues through that period, even in a shorter form, so three months of pace and stamina work does not quietly lapse.

faqs.question: Do you cover Thane and Navi Mumbai for weekly home classes?
faqs.answer: Yes, matched locally in both. In Thane we match from the station, Pokhran Road or Majiwada outward, because a Ghodbunder Road crossing at 7pm will break a weekly arrangement within a term. In Navi Mumbai we match node to node across Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel rather than sending a tutor over the Atal Setu twice a week. Where no Hindi A specialist is available locally, we say so and propose weekend home classes with online marking midweek instead of a weekday slot nobody will keep.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor and my child do not get on?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we replace the tutor from the same shortlist. Exam-focused work is more abrasive than general tutoring, because the whole point is somebody telling a teenager that their paragraph did not argue anything, so a certain amount of friction is the method working. The distinction worth drawing is between a student who finds the sessions hard and a student who has stopped writing anything between them. We pass the marked scripts to the new tutor, which means the diagnosis carries over and your child is not assessed from scratch.

sections.heading: How we match an IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai to one student
paragraphs: The message that arrives is rarely find a Hindi teacher. It is closer to this: my daughter is in DP1 at a school in the Western Suburbs, her individual oral is recorded after the winter break, she has spoken Hindi at home her whole life, and she has never built a paragraph of literary argument in it. Those are two separate problems. Matching an IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai starts by working out which one you actually have, because the tutor who builds confident speech is not always the tutor who can teach a student to read a poem closely.

The process is short on purpose. 1. You tell us the works your school has set, which Hindi A course your child is entered for, the year group, and your locality down to the building or the nearest station. 2. We shortlist tutors who have taught the oral and the written components of a Hindi A course, rather than graduates whose only qualification is that Hindi is their first language. 3. You speak to the shortlist yourself and choose one. 4. The first session is diagnostic: the tutor asks your child to talk about one set work without preparation, and listens for what is missing. 5. You get a written plan running to the next school deadline, not a twelve-month package.

Two details change the shortlist more than anything else. The first is the set works, because a tutor who has already taught the poetry collection your school chose can reach the actual difficulty in one session, while a tutor meeting it for the first time spends three sessions reading. The second is geography. A home tutor who lives in Chembur and teaches in Chembur keeps a standing Tuesday slot for two years; the same tutor pulled from Chembur to Andheri West every Tuesday at 6pm will quietly ask to move the slot by October. An IB private tutor Mumbai families keep for the whole Diploma is almost always one who lives inside the same travel pocket.

If the honest answer is that nobody on the shortlist has taught your exact works, we say so, and we tell you which tutor has taught the closest equivalent and how long the reading-in will take. IB Gram is an independent platform and we do not guarantee grades, so there is nothing to be gained by overselling a match that will not survive the first term.

sections.heading: Which Hindi A course your school entered your child for, and why it matters
paragraphs: Hindi A sits in the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) group that covers studies in language and literature, and it is a literature course taught in Hindi. It is not a language acquisition course. Nothing in it is designed around teaching a beginner to speak; it assumes the student can already read Hindi and asks what they can do with a text once they have read it. Schools offer Hindi A on one of the course routes the IB publishes, at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), and which route a school runs is a decision taken by the school, with the family, at the point of subject placement.

What follows from the route is the shape of the assessment. Across the two DP years a Hindi A student will meet a Paper 1 guided analysis on unseen material, a Paper 2 comparative essay on works studied, and the individual oral, which is marked inside the school and then moderated by the IB. Higher Level students carry an additional piece of written work. The names of the components are stable enough to plan around; the number of works, the permitted note format for the oral and the detail of the assessment criteria are revised on the IB subject guide cycle, so read the current guide and ask your DP coordinator rather than trusting a figure copied off a website.

The reason this matters to a parent arranging home tuition is simple. A tutor who has only taught Hindi as a second language, or only taught Hindi for a state or national board, will be competent at the language and may still be teaching the wrong thing. The DP wants an argument about a text, supported by close reading, expressed in formal written and spoken Hindi. A student can be the most fluent Hindi speaker in the room and still lose marks for retelling the plot in careful sentences.

Which course and which level your child takes is not something a tutor should be rearranging from the dining table. If a conversation about Higher Level or Standard Level is needed, it belongs with the DP coordinator and with you, and the deadline for it is the school's, not ours. A Hindi A IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families book should be teaching inside the decision the school has already recorded.

sections.heading: What does the IB DP Hindi A individual oral actually ask for?
paragraphs: The individual oral asks a student to show how a global issue they have chosen is presented in the works their school has set, using extracts they selected themselves, and to sustain that analysis in spoken Hindi for the length of the recording. It is assessed by the teacher inside the school and moderated by the International Baccalaureate (IB). How many works are involved, and of what kind, depends on the Hindi A route the school runs.

The global issue is where most orals are decided before the student opens their mouth. A student picks something enormous, say the position of women in society, and then discovers that the chosen novel carries it only in passing while the poem does not carry it at all. The test is not whether the issue sounds important. The test is whether both texts give enough to argue about: a repeated image, a structural choice, a narrator who keeps undercutting himself. A narrower issue that both works genuinely carry, for example how a family's silence about money shapes a daughter's choices, produces a tighter talk than a grand theme propped up by two thin examples.

The extract has to be dense. A passage that moves the plot along gives a student nothing but summary; a passage where the language is visibly working, where an image returns, where the syntax tightens, gives enough material for the whole talk. Then the harder half: the extract has to be tied back to the complete work. Examiners hear a great deal of careful reading of twenty lines followed by nothing at all about the book those lines came from. The student who says this image appears here, and again at the end, and the shift between the two is the point, is doing what the criteria ask for.

The last piece is register, and it is the piece most often missed in a household where Hindi is spoken every day. The oral is an analytical talk, not a conversation. It needs the vocabulary of Hindi criticism: terms for figures of speech, for imagery, for metre, for the aesthetic effect a passage produces, used accurately rather than decoratively. Hindi literature has a long critical tradition with a precise vocabulary built for exactly this work, and the student's job is to borrow it properly. Every variety of Hindi a student brings from home is a resource and none of it is a deficiency; what the course adds is a formal register for one particular kind of argument.

sections.heading: Where in Mumbai home tuition for Hindi A is available
paragraphs: An IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai is a scarcer match than a Maths or Physics tutor, which makes geography the first constraint rather than the last. In South Mumbai, home classes run in Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Churchgate, Walkeshwar and Worli, served by the Western Line from Churchgate to Mumbai Central, the Harbour Line through Dockyard, and now the Coastal Road and Metro Line 3 from Cuffe Parade towards BKC. The island is short on distance and long on time: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba can still lose most of an hour to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak, so matches here stay inside the island.

In the Western Suburbs, Hindi A home classes Mumbai families arrange sit along Bandra, Khar West, Santacruz West, Juhu, Andheri West, Goregaon East, Malad and Kandivali, strung between the Western Line, the Western Express Highway, Link Road and Metro Lines 2A and 7 from Dahisar to Gundavali. Matching along the line works; matching across it does not. In the Central Suburbs, tutors cover Kurla, Chembur, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli and Powai, with Metro Line 1 running Versova to Ghatkopar and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road cutting across. Powai is the exception worth planning for: it is physically central but has no station of its own, so a tutor arrives by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar and the JVLR decides whether that is a twenty minute trip or an hour.

Thane spreads from the station out along Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, and the Ghodbunder stretch sets the timetable more firmly than any other road in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

The practical rule we apply is this: a home tutor for Hindi A Mumbai students can rely on is one who lives inside the same travel pocket. sections.heading: How the Mumbai school calendar decides when the oral gets recorded
paragraphs: Mumbai's IB schools do not record the individual oral on the same date, and that date is the single most useful thing a parent can find out. Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School and the American School of Bombay in BKC, at Ecole Mondiale World School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, at Oberoi International School off the JVLR, at Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, at B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade and at D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul all work to a window the school sets for itself, generally somewhere between the later part of DP1 and the first months of DP2.

What makes the window hard is what sits beside it. A DP2 student in Mulund West at NES International School is often finishing an Extended Essay (EE) draft and a Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay in the same stretch as the Hindi A oral, with mock examinations just behind. Diwali and the winter break fall inside that run, and so do the weeks when half of Mumbai is travelling. The oral is the piece that slides, because it carries no external deadline the student can see on a calendar. It is also the piece hardest to rescue late, because rehearsal time cannot be compressed into a weekend.

The monsoon is the other calendar. From June into September, an evening home tuition slot on Ghodbunder Road or along the Western Express Highway is the first thing a waterlogged Tuesday takes away, which is why we set a standing online fallback at the start of a match rather than after the first cancellation. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of the schools named here, or with the International Baccalaureate organisation; schools appear on this page because their calendars are what Mumbai families actually plan around.

Ask the school three questions and the plan writes itself: the window in which the oral will be recorded, the set works for the year, and the note format the teacher will permit on the day. A tutor handed those three answers can build backwards from the recording. A tutor working without them is guessing, and in Hindi A, where set works vary widely between Mumbai schools, guessing costs a term.

sections.heading: Home classes, online or hybrid for oral practice?
paragraphs: For the individual oral, home classes are usually the better format in the early stages and online is the better format for rehearsal. A tutor sitting across a table hears hesitation, filler, and the exact moment a student stops arguing and starts retelling. A screen with a recording running is better for repetition, playback and marking against the criteria. Most families end up using both.

Home tuition for Hindi A has one advantage that is hard to replicate: the books are in the room. A tutor can take the set novel off the shelf, open it at the chapter the student has been avoiding, and work on the page with a pencil. Annotation in Hindi, in the margin, in the student's own hand, is most of the preparation for the oral, and it happens faster on paper with someone watching. An IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai also absorbs the week's disruption better: when a session has to move from Tuesday to Thursday because of a school event, a tutor who lives nearby can usually do it.

The trade-offs are real and worth stating plainly. A home tutor is limited to one travel pocket, so in Kharghar or Kasarvadavali the honest shortlist of Hindi A specialists may be short. An IB online tutor in Mumbai widens the shortlist to the whole city and beyond it, costs nothing in travel, and is better for the part of oral preparation that is pure repetition: speak, play it back, mark the three places where the argument thinned, speak again. What online loses is the shelf of books, the pencil, and the small physical cues that tell a tutor a student has stopped following.

Hybrid is what most Hindi A matches settle into by the second term, and it is worth setting up deliberately rather than drifting into it. One home session a week for close reading of the set works, one shorter online session for rehearsal and for marking the spoken draft against the criteria, and the monsoon problem solves itself. IB home tuition in Mumbai and online sessions are not competing products here; they do different jobs on the same task, and the ratio should change as the recording date comes closer.

sections.heading: How are Hindi A tutors in Mumbai checked before you meet them?
paragraphs: Every tutor on an IB Gram shortlist has had identity and contact details verified, has produced their degree and any teaching qualification, and has given a reference or a record of IB teaching. For Hindi A we also ask for a short taught sample: a passage of literary Hindi, analysed and explained the way they would explain it to a DP student who has not done the reading.

The checks we run do not replace the checks you run, and in a scarce subject yours matter more. Ask which Hindi A set works the tutor has actually taught, and listen for titles rather than categories. Ask them to analyse ten lines of literary Hindi in front of you, and watch whether they explain or merely translate. Ask what they would do if your child's chosen global issue turned out not to be carried by the second work. A tutor who answers that concretely has taught the oral. A Hindi A tutor in Mumbai who answers it with reassurance has not.

The boundary that matters most in this subject is authorship. A tutor may teach a student how to read, question an argument until it holds, mark a draft against the published criteria, and say plainly that a paragraph is summary and not analysis. A tutor may not write the script, redraft the student's sentences, choose the extracts, or supply any part of what the student hands in or says on the recording. The work has to be the student's own, and the school will ask the student to confirm that it is. If an IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai offers to prepare the oral for your child, that is the end of the conversation rather than a bargain.

Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, or who quotes the score your child will reach by March. IB Gram does not guarantee grades and no honest tutor does either; what a tutor can commit to is a method, a marking standard and attendance. The best IB tutor in Mumbai for your child is the one whose first session produced an uncomfortable and accurate list of what is missing.

sections.heading: Rehearsing the oral without memorising it
paragraphs: A memorised oral sounds exactly like a memorised oral, and it is one of the clearest ways to lose marks in Hindi A. The marks sit in analysis and in how a student handles their own argument under questioning, and a recitation does neither. It also collapses the moment the student loses their place, which happens often, because a script recited in a formal register is harder to hold than ordinary speech. A student who has rehearsed rather than memorised can lose a sentence and keep the argument.

Rehearsal that works looks like this. The student builds the talk as a short sequence of claims, each anchored to a line they can point to in the extract, written in the note format the teacher permits on the day. They then speak it, unscripted, into a phone recording, and play it back with the assessment criteria open beside them. The first playback is always unpleasant: the plot summary at the start, the long stretch where the second work vanished, the four times they said the poet is trying to say. The tutor's job during this phase is to ask the question after the talk, not to improve the talk.

That questioning is where a home tutor earns the slot. After the student speaks, the tutor pushes: why that image and not the one three lines above it, where else in the book does this happen, what would you say to a reader who took the passage the opposite way. Where a set text touches religion, caste or politics, that last question is the whole exercise, and the tutor's job is to show how different critics have read the passage and how to argue a position from evidence in the text, never to hand a student a verdict to repeat. A student asked these questions ten times across a few home sessions stops sounding rehearsed and starts sounding like someone who knows the book.

Delivery is the last layer and the smallest. Pace, audible pauses instead of filler, and a voice that stays in the analytical register rather than sliding into conversational Hindi halfway through. A tutor can coach all of that, and should. What a tutor cannot do is choose the extracts or write a word of the script, which means this work has to start earlier than most families expect, because the student is building it themselves and every revision has to pass through them.

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks, with roughly one session a week, the honest marker of progress is not a grade. It is that your child can open a set work at a page they have not prepared and say something analytical about it in Hindi for a minute or two without retelling the story. You should also see annotation appearing in the books: underlining with a reason written next to it. If after four weeks the sessions are still being spent translating the text into simpler Hindi, the match is wrong for this course, and that is worth raising immediately rather than at the end of term.

At one term, a Hindi A student working steadily should have a global issue they can defend, extracts chosen by themselves with reasons they can state out loud, and a talk they have delivered more than once, badly at first. They should be writing a Paper 2 comparative essay paragraph that makes a claim about both works rather than describing each in turn. School grades may not have moved yet, and that is not evidence of nothing happening: internal marking in a small Hindi A cohort moves slowly, and a Hindi A cohort in a Mumbai school can be a handful of students.

Across a full exam cycle the gains that hold are the ones about reading speed in literary Hindi and about writing formal Hindi under time pressure, because those two cannot be taught in the final month. The limits are just as real. A tutor cannot add reading hours the student does not put in, cannot sit the oral, and cannot repair two years of avoided reading in six weeks. We do not guarantee grades, and a tutor who implies otherwise is selling something other than teaching.

If it is not working, the sequence is short. Tell us what you are seeing in specifics: sessions running over on translation, no annotation in the books, a student who dreads Tuesday evening. We ask the tutor for their read, because the problem is sometimes a schedule or a clash of style rather than subject knowledge. If the gap is about the subject, we arrange a replacement from the same shortlist and pass on the diagnostic notes so the new tutor does not begin from zero.

sections.heading: Starting with a Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai: what the first session covers
paragraphs: Have four things ready and the first session is worth paying for. The list of set works, with editions if the school specified them. The oral recording window, as the school stated it. Your child's most recent piece of written Hindi with the teacher's comments still on it. And one honest sentence about what your child finds hard: reading speed, writing formally, speaking analytically, or simply having avoided the books. That last sentence saves more time than the other three together.

The first session is diagnostic and should feel like it. The tutor will ask your child to read a passage from a set work aloud and talk about it cold, will ask what their global issue might be and why, and will often find that the honest answer is nobody has asked me that yet. Nothing taught in the first hour cannot be revised later. What you should receive afterwards is a short written read: where the student stands on reading, on analysis and on register, and what the next four sessions will do about it.

A home tuition slot works best as a standing weekly appointment in a room with a door, a table and the books, with a parent in the flat rather than in the room. Where travel defeats that, a hybrid pattern does the same work. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the level, the scarcity of the subject, how far the tutor travels, session length and how many sessions a week you book; Hindi A sits at the scarce end, and travel distance moves the figure more than anything else, which is exactly why we match inside travel pockets.

faqs.question: How soon can a Hindi A home tutor start in our area?
faqs.answer: An IB DP Hindi A home tutor in Mumbai can usually start within a week in the main corridors, and takes longer in the outer nodes. Hindi A is a scarce subject, so availability is driven by geography more than by demand: a shortlist for Bandra, Khar West or Powai comes together quickly, while Kharghar, Panvel or Kasarvadavali can take longer or arrive as a hybrid option. If your child's oral window is close, say so in the first message, because that changes which tutors we approach and whether we suggest two shorter sessions a week instead of one.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to our building in Thane for a weekday evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the tutor is based in Thane, and that is the right way to arrange it. Ghodbunder Road at 7pm is why most cross-city arrangements fail by the second month: a tutor coming from Mulund West or Powai to Kasarvadavali will make the first four sessions and then start asking to shift the time. We match within Thane where a Hindi A specialist is available. Where one is not, we propose a weekend home session plus a midweek online session rather than a weekday evening slot that nobody will keep.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during a home tuition session?
faqs.answer: Someone should be in the flat, though not in the room. The reasons are practical: a tutor needs to be let in past the gate, sessions occasionally need a decision about rescheduling, and a closed-door session with a minor and no adult in the house is not a sensible arrangement for either side. Sitting in on the session is a different thing and usually unhelpful. For oral rehearsal in particular, a student who knows a parent is listening performs instead of thinking, and the entire value of rehearsal is in the mess.

faqs.question: What do tuition fees for Hindi A depend on?
faqs.answer: They depend on five things: Higher Level or Standard Level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels, how long each session runs, and how many sessions a week you book. Hindi A is scarcer in Mumbai than the common DP subjects, which pushes rates towards the upper end, and travel is the factor families underestimate: a tutor crossing from Andheri to Chembur twice a week is pricing an hour of the Western Express Highway into every session. We do not publish a rate card, because the honest answer is a range that depends on your postcode.

faqs.question: Can a tutor choose the global issue and the extracts for the individual oral?
faqs.answer: No. The global issue and the extracts have to be the student's own choices, and the school will expect the student to account for them. What a tutor should do is harder and more useful: put three candidate issues on the table, ask the student to find evidence for each in both works, and let the thin ones fail in front of them. If the student cannot find a repeated image, a structural pattern or a line they can point to, the issue is wrong, and discovering that in November is far better than discovering it in the recording.

faqs.question: Is a memorised script really penalised in the Hindi A oral?
faqs.answer: It costs marks, and it is audible within seconds. The criteria reward analysis and the way a student handles their own argument, and a recitation demonstrates neither; it also breaks badly when a line goes missing. Rehearsal is the alternative to memorisation: a short sequence of claims, each tied to a line in the extract, spoken aloud repeatedly in slightly different words, using the notes the teacher permits on the day. Ask the teacher what note format is allowed before building anything, because that detail comes from the current subject guide.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out?
faqs.answer: Tell us early and we arrange a replacement from the same shortlist. The useful version of that message is specific: four sessions spent translating rather than analysing, no annotation appearing in the set works, a student who has stopped doing the reading between sessions. We ask the tutor for their account too, because sometimes the problem is a schedule or a clash of style rather than subject knowledge. If it is the subject, we move, and the diagnostic notes go to the new tutor so your child is not re-diagnosed from scratch.

faqs.question: Can the tutor correct my child's oral script line by line?
faqs.answer: No, and this is a line worth being clear about before you start. A tutor may teach, question, and mark a draft against the published criteria, telling a student that a paragraph is summary rather than analysis or that the second work has quietly disappeared. A tutor may not write, redraft, or supply any part of what the student submits or says on the recording. The practical consequence is that preparation takes longer than families expect, because every improvement has to pass through the student. A tutor who offers to write it is a risk, not a shortcut.

faqs.question: Does online rehearsal work, or is home tuition better for the oral?
faqs.answer: Both, at different stages, and the split is worth planning in advance. Home sessions are better for close reading, because the set books are open on the table and the annotation happens in the student's own hand. Online sessions are better for rehearsal, because recording, playback and marking against the criteria are faster on a screen and a session can be arranged at short notice. Most Hindi A matches in Mumbai settle into one home session and one online session a week by the second term, and the online half doubles as monsoon insurance.

faqs.question: Our society gate requires a visitor pass for every entry. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: It is routine, as long as it is set up once rather than renegotiated weekly. Societies in Powai, Chembur, Kharghar and along Palm Beach Road generally allow standing entry for a regular tutor once the flat owner registers the name and timing with the committee or the gate app. Tell us at matching if your building needs photo identification, a police verification copy or a pre-registered vehicle, because that affects which tutors can realistically keep a 7pm slot. A tutor arguing at the gate for fifteen minutes loses a quarter of the session.

faqs.question: Do you cover Navi Mumbai for weekday Hindi A home classes?
faqs.answer: Yes, node by node: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel are matched from within Navi Mumbai rather than from the island city. Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway make node-to-node travel workable on a weekday evening, and the Atal Setu has changed the trip from South Mumbai, but a tutor crossing the creek twice a week for a 6pm lesson still rarely sustains it for a full DP year. Where no Hindi A specialist is free in your node, we say so and propose a hybrid pattern.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover the individual oral and the written papers?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and it is the better arrangement. The reading and the analytical vocabulary a student builds for the oral are the same ones the Paper 1 guided analysis and the Paper 2 comparative essay ask for, so splitting the work between two tutors tends to duplicate the easy part and skip the hard part. Ask a candidate how the oral preparation feeds the papers. A tutor who treats them as three separate projects has probably taught them that way. One tutor, two years, one set of books is the pattern that holds.

sections.heading: How IB Gram matches an IB DP Hindi A online tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: The useful question is not whether a tutor can teach over video. Almost anyone can talk over video. The question is whether they can run a Hindi A session on a screen: open the set text in a shared document, annotate a stanza line by line while the student watches the cursor, take a photograph of a handwritten paragraph the student sent that morning and mark it against the criteria, and keep all of it in one file the student can still open eighteen months later. Matching an IB DP Hindi A online tutor in Mumbai means filtering for that, not for availability.

The sequence we follow is deliberately mechanical. 1. You send the set works, which Hindi A course your child is entered for, the year group, and the two or three slots that genuinely exist in your week after school, sport and travel. 2. We shortlist Hindi A tutors who already teach the subject online and can show how they do it. 3. A short technical call happens before the first lesson: the shared document is created, screen share is tested, and the routine for photographing handwritten work is agreed. 4. Session one is diagnostic, and ends with the tutor reading aloud what they think is missing. 5. You get a written plan to the next school deadline.

Parents who have typed IB tutors near me Mumbai into a search box are usually surprised by how much the shortlist widens once travel comes out of the equation. A Hindi A specialist living in Mulund can teach a student in Kharghar on a Wednesday evening without either of them touching the Eastern Express Highway. For a subject with a thin pool of DP-experienced teachers in the city, that is the entire argument for online, and it is a good one.

What we will not do is pretend the format is free of cost. A screen removes travel and adds friction of its own, and the friction lands on written Hindi. IB Gram is an independent platform, we do not guarantee grades, and we would rather set up a workable hybrid in week one than sell a clean online schedule that quietly stops producing handwritten work by October.

sections.heading: Which parts of the Hindi A course an online tutor can actually teach
paragraphs: Hindi A belongs to the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) group covering studies in language and literature, taken at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL) across Years 1 and 2. It is a literature course conducted in Hindi, not a course in acquiring the language, and that distinction decides what a tutor is for. The student is expected to read Hindi already; the course asks what they can argue about what they have read. Which route and level a student takes is settled by the school together with the family at placement, and a tutor works inside that decision.

Mapped against the components, the online format is uneven in a predictable way. Discussion, close reading, the building of critical vocabulary and the rehearsal of spoken analysis all transfer cleanly to a screen. The Paper 1 guided analysis and the Paper 2 comparative essay transfer only halfway, because the thinking transfers and the handwriting does not. The individual oral sits in between: it is spoken, so video suits it, but it is recorded at school under the teacher's arrangements. A Hindi A IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai parents hire online should be able to say which of these they will do on screen and which will be set as handwritten work.

Component detail belongs to the current subject guide, and the guide changes on the IB's own cycle. The number of works studied, the note format permitted in the oral, and the wording of the assessment criteria are all things to read from the live guide or ask the DP coordinator for, not to take from a tutor's memory of an older cohort. A good online tutor will have the current criteria open in the shared document, which is one of the quieter advantages of working this way.

An IB private tutor Mumbai families engage for Hindi A will also be the person who notices structural problems the school has not flagged: a student who has never finished one of the set works, or who has been reading summaries in English. Those are findable in one session on a screen, because the tutor can ask the student to scroll to a page and read.

sections.heading: How does line-by-line annotation work in an online Hindi A session?
paragraphs: The set passage goes into a shared document, the tutor screen-shares it, and the two of them mark it up together while the student watches each comment land on a specific line. Nothing is summarised. By the end of a session a stanza carries a colour for repeated images, a margin note for the shift in the speaker's stance, and two Hindi critical terms attached to the lines that earned them.

That is more useful than it sounds, because the most common weakness in a Hindi A script is a student writing about a whole text while quoting nothing from it. Annotation forces the opposite habit. A paragraph of Hindi prose gets numbered lines; the tutor asks which word the student would remove and what breaks if they do; the answer is typed into the margin in the student's own words. Over two terms that document becomes a record of how the student's reading actually changed, which is far more informative than a grade in a report.

The second thing a shared file does is hold a vocabulary of criticism. Hindi literature has a long and precise critical tradition, with established terms for figures of speech, for imagery, for metre and for the aesthetic effect a passage produces. Students arrive able to feel that a poem is doing something and unable to name it. A running glossary with three columns, the Hindi term, a plain gloss, and a line from a set work where it applies, is the single most reused page in the file. It is built slowly, by the student, and it is what makes a Paper 1 guided analysis sound like analysis rather than appreciation.

A third section of the file holds passages: the extracts from set works that the class has treated as important, with the page reference and the student's own note on why. By DP2 this is a revision resource nothing else replaces, and it exists only because somebody kept it from the first month. Marking an essay is the fourth use. Comments are anchored to the student's own sentences, so the feedback reads this clause asserts something the quotation does not support, rather than a tidy rewritten version the student will copy without learning anything.
